words.englishDefinition: to move or travel to another place
words.japaneseExplanation: 別の場所へ移動すること。go to school で学校へ行く。
words.example: I go to school by bus every morning.

words.englishDefinition: to get something by paying money for it
words.japaneseExplanation: お金を払って物を手に入れること。
words.example: I need to buy some bread for breakfast.

words.englishDefinition: to obtain or receive something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを手に入れたり、受け取ったりすること。
words.example: Where can I get a ticket for the concert?

words.englishDefinition: to notice with your eyes; to meet someone
words.japaneseExplanation: 目で見ることや、人に会うこと。文脈で意味が変わる。
words.example: I can see the mountains from my window.

words.englishDefinition: to move toward the speaker or a particular place
words.japaneseExplanation: 話し手のいる場所などに向かって来ること。
words.example: Can you come to my house after school?

words.englishDefinition: a place where you pay to eat a meal
words.japaneseExplanation: 代金を払って食事をする店。
words.example: Let's try the new restaurant near the station.

words.englishDefinition: an outdoor public area where people can relax and play
words.japaneseExplanation: 散歩や遊びなどができる公共の場所。
words.example: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.

words.englishDefinition: a story shown in moving pictures
words.japaneseExplanation: 映像で物語などを見せる映画。
words.example: Would you like to watch a movie tonight?

words.englishDefinition: a connected group of railway vehicles
words.japaneseExplanation: 線路の上を走る列車や電車。
words.example: The next train leaves in ten minutes.

words.englishDefinition: A mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスの小売販売のための商業の施設。
words.example: I bought eggs at the store on the way home.

words.englishDefinition: a place where trains stop for passengers
words.japaneseExplanation: 列車に乗ったり降りたりする駅。
words.example: I'll meet you outside the station at nine.

words.englishDefinition: The facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition
words.japaneseExplanation: 野生動物が展示のために飼われている設備。
words.example: How many animals do you think are in this zoo?

words.englishDefinition: A wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの車輪があり、足のペダルで動く車両。
words.example: I don't like cars, so I always ride a bike.

words.englishDefinition: A small vessel for travel on water
words.japaneseExplanation: 水上を行くための小さい船。
words.example: What good is a boat going to do us now?

words.englishDefinition: A building where travelers can pay for lodging and meals and other services
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行者が宿と食事その他のサービスを買える建物。
words.example: I stayed at the hotel, but the others went shopping.

words.englishDefinition: after the expected or usual time
words.japaneseExplanation: 予定や普段の時刻より遅いこと。
words.example: Sorry I'm late. I missed the bus.

words.englishDefinition: Immediately past
words.japaneseExplanation: すぐ前の過去の。
words.example: We could go out together like we did last year.

words.englishDefinition: of a pleasing or satisfactory quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 質や状態がよいこと。人については親切なども表す。
words.example: That sounds like a good idea for our class.

words.englishDefinition: Immediately following in time or order
words.japaneseExplanation: 直ちに時間あるいは命令に続くさま。
words.example: We will be studying very hard this time next year.

words.japanese: 大好きな、お気に入りの
words.englishDefinition: liked more than others
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかのものより特に好きなこと。
words.example: What is your favorite food to cook at home?

words.englishDefinition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
words.japaneseExplanation: 鉛筆やペンなどで絵や図を描くこと。
words.example: Can you draw a picture of your favorite animal?

words.englishDefinition: Reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的地に着く。動くことまたは前進によって到着する。
words.example: We won't be able to arrive home in time.

words.englishDefinition: Sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、動物の動きを制御してその背中に座って旅をする。
words.example: Can you teach me how to ride a horse?

words.englishDefinition: to make a picture or cover a surface using paint
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵の具で絵を描くことや、塗料を塗ること。
words.example: We are going to paint the classroom walls blue.

words.englishDefinition: Separate with or as if with an instrument
words.japaneseExplanation: 器具であるいは器具を用いたかのように分ける。
words.example: You should cut up your meat before you eat it.

words.englishDefinition: the sandy or stony land beside the sea
words.japaneseExplanation: 海辺にある砂や小石の浜。
words.example: We walked along the beach after lunch.

words.englishDefinition: An airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅客や貨物のための設備のみならず管制塔やハンガーなどを備えた飛行場。
words.example: How much will it cost to get to the airport?

words.englishDefinition: An excavation that is (usually) filled with water
words.japaneseExplanation: （普通）水が一杯の穴。
words.example: I filled the pool with water.

words.englishDefinition: A wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの車輪があり、足のペダルで動く車両。
words.example: I will give you this bicycle as a birthday present.

words.englishDefinition: in or toward the south
words.japaneseExplanation: 南側の位置や方向を表す形容詞。
words.example: The south side of the house gets more sunlight.

words.englishDefinition: A building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented
words.japaneseExplanation: 演劇や映画が上演される建物。
words.example: Could you show me the way to the theater?

words.englishDefinition: A suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常アパートの階全部の部屋の一そろい。
words.example: Do you live in a house or an apartment?

words.englishDefinition: A financial institution that accepts deposits and channels the money into lending activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 預金を受け付け、その金を貸付業務に回す金融機関。
words.example: I have to take some money out of the bank.

words.englishDefinition: Any particular collection of letters or packages that is delivered
words.japaneseExplanation: 配達される手紙や小包の任意の集まり。
words.example: I went to the post office to mail a letter.

words.englishDefinition: An institution created to conduct business
words.japaneseExplanation: 事業を行うために創設された機関。
words.example: I wanted to start a company, but I never got started.

words.englishDefinition: containing as much as possible; having eaten enough
words.japaneseExplanation: 空きがないことや、食べて満腹であること。
words.example: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.

words.englishDefinition: Not correct; not in conformity with fact or truth
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しくない。事実または真実と符合することない。
words.example: You were on that road at the wrong time.

words.englishDefinition: not difficult
words.japaneseExplanation: あまり苦労せずにできること。
words.example: This book is easy enough for me to read.

words.englishDefinition: weighing a lot
words.japaneseExplanation: 重さが大きく、持つのに力が必要なこと。
words.example: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.

words.englishDefinition: Engaged in by members of a profession
words.japaneseExplanation: 専門職のメンバーが従事している。
words.example: You play the guitar quite like a professional, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: to pick up or carry something
words.japaneseExplanation: 物を手に取ったり、別の場所へ持っていったりすること。
words.example: Please take your umbrella with you today.

words.englishDefinition: to create or produce something
words.japaneseExplanation: 材料や考えを使って何かを作り出すこと。
words.example: Let's make a birthday card for our teacher.

words.englishDefinition: to go to see a person or place
words.japaneseExplanation: 人に会ったり場所を見たりするために訪ねること。
words.example: We visit my grandparents every Sunday afternoon.

words.englishDefinition: Perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards
words.japaneseExplanation: 注意して知覚する。その人の視線を向ける。
words.example: I will look after your child this evening.

words.englishDefinition: Come together
words.japaneseExplanation: 団結する。
words.example: I am looking forward to meeting you when you come.

words.englishDefinition: A plot of ground where plants are cultivated
words.japaneseExplanation: 植物を耕す小区画地。
words.example: What did you plant in your garden this year?

words.englishDefinition: A large self-service grocery store selling groceries and dairy products and household goods
words.japaneseExplanation: 食料雑貨および乳製品および家庭用品を販売する大きいセルフサービスの食料雑貨品店。
words.example: We see each other at the supermarket now and then.

words.englishDefinition: A land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill
words.japaneseExplanation: 周りのものを超えて目立つ土地の塊。丘より高い。
words.example: You can't get through the mountain pass in the winter.

words.englishDefinition: An urban area with a fixed boundary that is smaller than a city
words.japaneseExplanation: 決まった境界がある都市区域で、市よりも小さい。
words.example: I drove past this town on the way home.

words.englishDefinition: Workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 農場の建物および耕地を一体にしたもの。
words.example: I worked a couple of years as a farm hand.

words.englishDefinition: A health facility where patients receive treatment
words.japaneseExplanation: 患者が治療を受ける健康設備。
words.example: I went to the hospital to ask about his health.

words.englishDefinition: A point located with respect to surface features of some region
words.japaneseExplanation: ある地域の表面の特徴に関して見つけられたポイント。
words.example: I know a place where we can get some money.

words.englishDefinition: A depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value
words.japaneseExplanation: 科学的、歴史的、あるいは芸術的に価値のあるものを蒐集し展示するための保管所。
words.example: How much money has been spent on building the museum?

words.englishDefinition: An aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
words.japaneseExplanation: 翼を固定しプロペラあるいはジェットエンジンで動く飛行機。
words.example: What time is your plane due to take off?

words.englishDefinition: a road in a town or city, usually with buildings beside it
words.japaneseExplanation: 町や市街地の建物が並ぶ道路。
words.example: There is a small bakery across the street.

words.englishDefinition: Having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
words.japaneseExplanation: 疑いまたは不確実性を持たないか感じないさま。自信があって確実な。
words.example: I was sure I had never seen her before.

words.englishDefinition: Feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをした、あるいはしなかったことについて後悔、悲しみ、あるいは喪失感を感じること、あるいは表すさま。
words.example: We feel sorry about what happened between you.

words.japanese: 幸福な、楽しい、うれしい
words.englishDefinition: Enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 嬉しさや喜びを楽しむこと、見せること、あるいは特徴とするさま。
words.example: I remember the happy days we spent together.

words.englishDefinition: prepared to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な準備ができていること。ready to の後ろは動詞の原形。
words.example: Are you ready to leave for school?

words.englishDefinition: Free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth
words.japaneseExplanation: エラーがない。特に事実や真実に従う。
words.example: You took the words right out of my mouth.

words.englishDefinition: Invite someone to one's house
words.japaneseExplanation: 家に人を招待する。
words.example: I would like to invite you to dinner.

words.englishDefinition: to give something to someone in exchange for money
words.japaneseExplanation: 代金を受け取って商品などを相手に渡すこと。
words.example: They sell fresh bread at the shop near my house.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to become awake or conscious
words.japaneseExplanation: 目が覚める、意識がある。
words.example: Please wake me at six am.

words.englishDefinition: to let something fall
words.japaneseExplanation: 持っている物などを下へ落とすこと。
words.example: Be careful not to drop your phone.

words.englishDefinition: to store information or sound so it can be used later
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報や音などを後で使えるように残すこと。
words.example: Can I record the lesson to review it later?

words.englishDefinition: A place off to the side of an area
words.japaneseExplanation: ある領域の外れの場所。
words.example: Our favorite place to eat is that small restaurant on the corner.

words.englishDefinition: A portable shelter (usually of canvas stretched over supporting poles and fastened to the ground with ropes and pegs)
words.japaneseExplanation: 携帯用の住居（通常帆布製で支柱の上に広げロープと杭で地面に固定する）。
words.example: I set the tent up near the lake.

words.englishDefinition: A commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers
words.japaneseExplanation: 乗客のためのスケジュールを供給する営利事業。
words.example: I've always wanted to work for an airline.

words.englishDefinition: A structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place
words.japaneseExplanation: 屋根と壁があり、1つの場所にほぼ永久的に立っている構造物。
words.example: We don't need more than one coffee shop in this building.

words.englishDefinition: The town (or city) where you grew up or where you have your principal residence
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分が育った、あるいは主に生活していた町（あるいは市）。
words.example: What are some things you like about your hometown?

words.englishDefinition: A private box for delivery of mail
words.japaneseExplanation: 郵便を受け取るための個人的な箱。
words.example: Please don't forget to put the letter into the mailbox.

words.englishDefinition: in or toward the north
words.japaneseExplanation: 北側の位置や方向を表す形容詞。
words.example: The north entrance is closed for repairs today.

words.englishDefinition: A small lake
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さな湖。
words.example: We saw a lot of live fish in the pond.

words.englishDefinition: An electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)
words.japaneseExplanation: 地下を走る電車（通常都市で）。
words.example: I always take the subway, to go to the city.

words.englishDefinition: A structure taller than its diameter; can stand alone or be attached to a larger building
words.japaneseExplanation: 直径より高い構造物。独立して立っていることも、より大きな建物に付属していることもある。
words.example: I can see the tower from where I stand.

words.englishDefinition: Same in identity
words.japaneseExplanation: アイデンティティが同じである。
words.example: I thought that we were on the same side.

words.englishDefinition: Feeling or showing anger
words.japaneseExplanation: 怒りを感じるか、示すさま。
words.example: I was still feeling angry.

words.englishDefinition: Soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime
words.japaneseExplanation: 汚れまたはほこり汚れたまたは汚れるような。
words.example: My shirt is clean, and yours is dirty.

words.englishDefinition: Having an abundant supply of desirable qualities or substances (especially natural resources)
words.japaneseExplanation: 価値のある品質か物質（特に天然資源）が豊富に供給されるさま。
words.example: I am not rich, nor do I wish to be.

words.englishDefinition: Not moving quickly; taking a comparatively long time
words.japaneseExplanation: すばやく動かないさま。比較的長い時間を要すること。
words.example: You probably think this song is a little too slow.

words.englishDefinition: Exchange thoughts; talk with
words.japaneseExplanation: 考えを言い合う。話す。
words.example: We need to talk to each other more often.

words.englishDefinition: Dwell
words.japaneseExplanation: 居住する。
words.example: Do you think she still wants me to stay with her?

words.englishDefinition: Inhabit or live in; be an inhabitant of
words.japaneseExplanation: 居住するか、生きる。住民である。
words.example: I came to live here three years ago.

words.englishDefinition: to remove dirt from something
words.japaneseExplanation: 汚れを取り除いてきれいにすること。
words.example: Please clean your desk before you go home.

words.englishDefinition: Exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的のためにまたは必要に迫られて、精神的、物理的な行動をすることによって尽力する。
words.example: I must work hard to make up for lost time.

words.englishDefinition: A large structure for open-air sports or entertainments
words.japaneseExplanation: 野外で行うスポーツや催し物のための大きな建造物。
words.example: How long does it take to get to the stadium?

words.englishDefinition: An open way (generally public) for travel or transportation
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行や輸送用の（一般的に公の）自由な道。
words.example: What is written on the road sign? - ONE WAY.

words.englishDefinition: A large building for meetings or entertainment
words.japaneseExplanation: 会合や娯楽用の大きい建物。
words.example: My friends are waiting in the hall, ready to leave.

words.englishDefinition: A structure that allows people or vehicles to cross an obstacle such as a river or canal or railway etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 川・運河・鉄道などの障害物を人や車が横断できるようにする構造物。
words.example: We weren't allowed to cross the bridge.

words.englishDefinition: Preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home)
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校外で（特に家庭で）なされる準備的な学習作業。
words.example: I had my homework all done by the time my mother got home.

words.englishDefinition: a group of people who meet for a shared activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ趣味や活動のために集まるクラブや部。
words.example: I joined the tennis club at my school.

words.englishDefinition: A depository built to contain books and other materials for reading and study
words.japaneseExplanation: 本と研究のために、本と他の資料を保存するために建設される保管所。
words.example: I like to go to the library and read books.

words.englishDefinition: a group of students or a lesson they attend
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に学ぶ生徒の集まり、または授業。
words.example: We have an English class on Monday mornings.

words.englishDefinition: a set of questions or tasks that checks knowledge or ability
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識や能力を確かめるための問題や課題。
words.example: We have a vocabulary test at school tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: A branch of knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識の分野。
words.example: What more is there to say on this subject?

words.englishDefinition: Very good
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常によい。
words.example: I want you to know you did a great job.

words.englishDefinition: Actively or fully engaged or occupied
words.japaneseExplanation: 活発に、完全に、占められた、独占された。
words.example: I was too busy to eat lunch.

words.englishDefinition: well or in a satisfactory condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 体調や状態がよいこと。「大丈夫」の意味でも使う。
words.example: I had a headache, but I feel fine now.

words.englishDefinition: Feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food
words.japaneseExplanation: 飢えを感じるさま。食物を食べる必要または願望を感じること。
words.example: Please give me something to eat. I am so hungry.

words.englishDefinition: At or near the beginning of a period of time or course of events or before the usual or expected time
words.japaneseExplanation: 始まりにおいて、または、期間かすう勢の始まりの近くか以前、普通であるか期待が調節されます。
words.example: We left early in the morning before it got light.

words.englishDefinition: A unit of instruction
words.japaneseExplanation: 指示部隊。
words.example: I want to put off the lesson until another day.

words.englishDefinition: A reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
words.japaneseExplanation: 単語に関する情報が載っている単語のアルファベット順のリストを含む参考図書。
words.example: I can't understand this word. Do you have a dictionary?

words.englishDefinition: An occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
words.japaneseExplanation: 2人以上の競争者から勝者が選ばれる機会。
words.example: I thought that you were going to win the contest.

words.englishDefinition: The act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience
words.japaneseExplanation: 聴衆に対して正式に口頭で伝達する行為。
words.example: I doubt that he can make a speech in public.

words.englishDefinition: A dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage
words.japaneseExplanation: ステージでの俳優による演技を目的とする劇の仕事。
words.example: You want some drama? I'll give you some drama!

words.englishDefinition: a spoken or written account of information
words.japaneseExplanation: 調べたことや起きたことをまとめた報告。
words.example: I need to finish my report by Friday.

words.englishDefinition: The yard associated with a school
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校に付属している庭。
words.example: I am standing in the middle of the schoolyard.

words.englishDefinition: A school for young children; usually the first 6 or 8 grades
words.japaneseExplanation: 幼い子供たちのための学校。通常は最初の6学年か8学年。
words.example: Our children were at the same elementary school.

words.englishDefinition: A book prepared for use in schools or colleges
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校または大学で使うために準備された本。
words.example: I forgot to buy the textbook.

words.englishDefinition: Sheet of slate; for writing with chalk
words.japaneseExplanation: 粘板岩の板。チョークで書くための。
words.example: I broke my glasses, so I couldn't see the blackboard.

words.englishDefinition: related to society or activities with other people
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会に関係することや、人と交流する活動を表す。
words.example: The club organizes social events for new students.

words.englishDefinition: Abounding in or exposed to the wind or breezes
words.japaneseExplanation: 風か微風に富むか、またはさらされている。
words.example: You can't play tennis on days when it's very windy.

words.englishDefinition: High in price or charging high prices
words.japaneseExplanation: 値段が高い、または高い値段で請求する。
words.example: I can't afford to shop at such an expensive store.

words.englishDefinition: Less than normal in degree or intensity or amount
words.japaneseExplanation: 程度、強さまたは量で通常以下である。
words.example: Our prices are so low, we must be crazy!

words.englishDefinition: Having or bringing good fortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸運を持っている、あるいはもたらすさま。
words.example: I was lucky enough to get a good seat.

words.englishDefinition: Accomplished rapidly and without delay
words.japaneseExplanation: 急速に即刻達成される。
words.example: My brother is quick to make friends with anybody.

words.englishDefinition: Free from danger or the risk of harm
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険や危害のリスクがない。
words.example: I will take you to a safe place.

words.englishDefinition: Having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
words.japaneseExplanation: ほとんど部品を持たないさま。複雑でない、面倒でない、あるいは入り組んでいない。
words.example: We came up with a very simple solution to the problem.

words.englishDefinition: Having strength or power greater than average or expected
words.japaneseExplanation: 強さまたは力を平均より大きいか期待されたようにしておくさま。
words.example: My father used to be a strong man.

words.englishDefinition: Having or denoting the characteristic taste of sugar
words.japaneseExplanation: 砂糖の特有の味を持つこと、または示すさま。
words.example: I saw a little girl who was sweet and happy.

words.englishDefinition: Take in solid food
words.japaneseExplanation: 固形食物を取り入れる。
words.example: What kind of food do you not like to eat?

words.englishDefinition: Have need of
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要性を有する。
words.example: You will need much more money than you do now.

words.englishDefinition: Interpret something that is written or printed
words.japaneseExplanation: 書かれているか、または印刷される何かを解釈する。
words.example: You should read books written in English.

words.englishDefinition: to contact someone by telephone; to ask someone to come
words.japaneseExplanation: 電話をかけたり、誰かを呼んだりすること。
words.example: I'll call you when I get to the station.

words.englishDefinition: to prepare food by heating it
words.japaneseExplanation: 材料を加熱するなどして食事を作ること。
words.example: I usually cook dinner for my family on Sundays.

words.englishDefinition: A science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement
words.japaneseExplanation: 量、形、配列の論理を研究している科学（または関連した科学のグループ）。
words.example: I worked hard in order to pass the math test.

words.englishDefinition: An institution of higher education created to educate and grant degrees; often a part of a university
words.japaneseExplanation: 教育と学位授与のために創設された高等教育機関。しばしば総合大学の一部。
words.example: I often ate at that restaurant when I was a college student.

words.englishDefinition: A book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda
words.japaneseExplanation: メモまたは覚書を記録するための空白のページがある本。
words.example: You can write in that notebook since it's yours.

words.englishDefinition: The aggregate of past events
words.japaneseExplanation: 過去の出来事の集合体。
words.example: I understand you're interested in the history of this place.

words.englishDefinition: A particular branch of scientific knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 科学知識の特定の領域。
words.example: I like my French class better than my science class.

words.englishDefinition: A restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
words.japaneseExplanation: セルフサービス形式でキャッシャーで代金を支払う。
words.example: Can you meet me in the cafeteria in ten minutes?

words.englishDefinition: The inside lower horizontal surface (as of a room, hallway, tent, or other structure)
words.japaneseExplanation: （部屋、廊下、テント、またはその他の建造物の）内側の、下側の水平面。
words.example: We had to sleep on the floor.

words.englishDefinition: General line of orientation
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体的な方向性。
words.example: Do you also want to take part in this course?

words.englishDefinition: A diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it)
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の表面（あるいはその一部）の図式的な表示。
words.example: Can you tell me where I am on this map?

words.englishDefinition: An instance of questioning
words.japaneseExplanation: 質問の例。
words.example: We talked about the question over a cup of coffee.

words.englishDefinition: Able to act at will; not hampered; not under compulsion or restraint
words.japaneseExplanation: 意のままに行動することができる。妨げられない。
words.example: Please feel free to stay as long as you like.

words.englishDefinition: not closed
words.japaneseExplanation: ドアなどが閉じていない状態を表す。
words.example: Please leave the window open for a few minutes.

words.englishDefinition: used to greet someone arriving somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 人を迎えるときの「ようこそ」という挨拶。
words.example: Welcome to our school! Let me show you around.

words.englishDefinition: Dearly loved
words.japaneseExplanation: 心から愛されている。
words.example: My mother has sold everything that is dear to her.

words.englishDefinition: For a special service or occasion
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別のサービスまたは機会のために。
words.example: You and I had something really special.

words.englishDefinition: An implement used to erase something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを消去するのに用いられる道具。
words.example: Do you have an eraser I could borrow?

words.englishDefinition: a year or level in school
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校での学年を表す。成績の意味でも使う。
words.example: My brother is in the fifth grade this year.

words.englishDefinition: One side of one leaf (of a book or magazine or newspaper or letter etc.) or the written or pictorial matter it contains
words.japaneseExplanation: 1枚の葉（本または雑誌または新聞紙または手紙その他の。）の一方またはそれが含む書面にしたか絵の問題。
words.example: I turn over a page of the book.

words.englishDefinition: Any informal meal eaten outside or on an excursion
words.japaneseExplanation: 屋外または遠足で食べる気軽な食事。
words.example: Do you want to go on a picnic with me?

words.englishDefinition: The act of someone who fishes as a diversion
words.japaneseExplanation: 気晴らしとして魚を釣る人の行為。
words.example: We were really hoping to buy a fishing boat.

words.englishDefinition: The act of encamping and living in tents in a camp
words.japaneseExplanation: 野営地で露営し、テントに住む行為。
words.example: Our tent was the only one in the camping area.

words.englishDefinition: The evening before All Saints' Day; often devoted to pranks played by young people
words.japaneseExplanation: 諸聖人の日の前の夕方。しばしば若者たちのいたずらが行われる。
words.example: I was at a Halloween party for a few hours.

words.englishDefinition: an activity you enjoy doing in your free time
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由な時間に楽しむ趣味。
words.example: My favorite hobby is taking photos of birds.

words.englishDefinition: Creating a picture with paints
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵の具で絵を作成すること。
words.example: I still think we should've bought the painting you liked.

words.englishDefinition: a mother or father
words.japaneseExplanation: 母親または父親を表す。parents なら両親などの複数。
words.example: Each child must come with a parent.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の習慣または手順に従って起こる、遭遇する、経験する、あるいはしばしば観察されるさま。
words.example: I arrived late because I didn't get up at my usual time.

words.englishDefinition: The present or immediately coming night
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在かすぐに来る夜。
words.example: I have a feeling that tonight is going to be a good night!

words.englishDefinition: According to the clock
words.japaneseExplanation: 時計によって。
words.example: My watch says that it's three o'clock.

words.englishDefinition: two times
words.japaneseExplanation: 回数が二回であること。量の二倍も表せる。
words.example: I practice the piano twice a week.

words.englishDefinition: in or to a place that is not inside
words.japaneseExplanation: 建物などの外側にいることや、外へ移動すること。
words.example: Let's play outside after we finish our homework.

words.englishDefinition: Some unspecified time in the future
words.japaneseExplanation: 将来のある不特定の時。
words.example: I will get even with you someday. Remember that.

words.englishDefinition: Without speed ('slow' is sometimes used informally for 'slowly')
words.japaneseExplanation: 速度なしで。
words.example: I spoke slowly so that they might understand me.

words.japanese: (過去・未来の)いつか、そのうち
words.englishDefinition: At some indefinite or unstated time
words.japaneseExplanation: いくつかの不明確であるか述べられていない時刻に。
words.example: We must get together for a drink sometime.

words.englishDefinition: Prior to a specified or implied time
words.japaneseExplanation: 指定されたか意味された時間の前に。
words.example: I must have told you that a hundred times already.

words.englishDefinition: used for imagined situations, polite requests, or the past form of will
words.japaneseExplanation: 仮定の話や丁寧な依頼で使う助動詞。後ろは動詞の原形。
words.example: Would you like some help with your homework?

words.englishDefinition: Inquire about
words.japaneseExplanation: 尋ねる。
words.example: I went to the hospital to ask about his health.

words.englishDefinition: Express gratitude or show appreciation to
words.japaneseExplanation: 感謝の意を表す、または謝意を示す。
words.example: I would like to thank you for your great job.

words.englishDefinition: Produce a literary work
words.japaneseExplanation: 文学作品を作り出す。
words.example: I tried to write down everything he said.

words.englishDefinition: Travel through water
words.japaneseExplanation: 水を通して移動する。
words.example: We used to swim every day when we were children.

words.englishDefinition: Derive or receive pleasure from; get enjoyment from; take pleasure in
words.japaneseExplanation: 喜びを引き出す、または受ける。悦楽を得る。
words.example: I never thought I would enjoy living in the country.

words.englishDefinition: Athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training
words.japaneseExplanation: スポーツやトレーニングの設備が揃った運動施設。
words.example: We train every day at the gym.

words.englishDefinition: An acquaintance that you go to school with
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ学校の知り合い。
words.example: My sister got married with her classmate from high school.

words.englishDefinition: A material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses
words.japaneseExplanation: セルロースパルプで作られる素材で、主に木、古着またはある種の草から得られる。
words.example: I made a paper plane.

words.englishDefinition: An examination consisting of a few short questions
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い質問からなる試験。
words.example: We will have a quiz at the end of class today.

words.englishDefinition: Clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のグループの構成員が所属を明確にするために着る、特有のデザインの服。
words.example: You weren't wearing your uniform the last time I saw you.

words.englishDefinition: A room in a school where lessons take place
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校で授業の行われる部屋。
words.example: I stayed after school to help clean the classroom.

words.englishDefinition: The day after today
words.japaneseExplanation: 今日の次の日。
words.example: Please do that tomorrow or the day after tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: The momentary present
words.japaneseExplanation: 瞬間的な現在。
words.example: I think that now isn't a good time to do that.

words.englishDefinition: A time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、金曜日の夜から日曜日までの期間。日曜日、あるいは一度のみの日曜日を含む連続した日付期間のいずれかであると緩く定義された。
words.example: I want to spend time with my children this weekend.

words.englishDefinition: One of the twelve divisions of the calendar year
words.japaneseExplanation: 暦年を12に分けた中の1つ。
words.example: I get paid at the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: Depleted of strength or energy
words.japaneseExplanation: 力またはエネルギーを消耗した。
words.example: My mother was too tired, so she went to bed early.

words.englishDefinition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡単でない。完成させ、理解しまたは我慢する物理的または精神的努力を必要とする。
words.example: I realize this is a difficult time for you.

words.englishDefinition: one and no more
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかに同じものがなく、ただ一つであること。
words.example: This is the only key to the classroom.

words.englishDefinition: Affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の身体的であるか精神的な機能の減退に影響を受ける。
words.example: I have never been sick since I was a child.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by dissimilarity
words.japaneseExplanation: 相違点によってマークされる。
words.example: You and I are very different from each other.

words.englishDefinition: Any number of entities (members) considered as a unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 1単位として考えられるいくつかの実体（メンバー）。
words.example: How long have you been a member of this group?

words.englishDefinition: A parent of your father or mother
words.japaneseExplanation: 父あるいは母の親。
words.example: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.

words.englishDefinition: Writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業的（報酬のため）に（本、物語、記事、または、そのようなものを）書く。
words.example: I knew both the writer and the book.

words.englishDefinition: A person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination
words.japaneseExplanation: 感性と想像力あふれる作品を生み出す人。
words.example: I love your work, and I respect you as an artist.

words.englishDefinition: A theatrical performer
words.japaneseExplanation: 劇の演技者。
words.example: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?

words.englishDefinition: A married woman; a man's partner in marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 結婚している女性。結婚における男性のパートナー。
words.example: I slept with my wife before we were married. Did you?

words.englishDefinition: The child of your aunt or uncle
words.japaneseExplanation: おじやおばの子供。
words.example: My cousin is the last person to break his promise.

words.englishDefinition: A married man; a woman's partner in marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 結婚した男性。結婚によってある女性の配偶者となった人。
words.example: I am a man and my husband is also a man.

words.englishDefinition: The operator of a motor vehicle
words.japaneseExplanation: 自動車を運転する人。
words.example: Please do not talk to the driver while he's driving.

words.englishDefinition: A person who plays the piano
words.japaneseExplanation: ピアノを演奏する人。
words.example: I know nothing about her except that she is a pianist.

words.englishDefinition: the same female person as the subject
words.japaneseExplanation: 主語の女性と同じ人を指す。by herself は「一人で」。
words.example: She made this birthday cake all by herself.

words.englishDefinition: the same male person as the subject
words.japaneseExplanation: 主語の男性と同じ人を指す。by himself は「一人で」。
words.example: He taught himself to play the guitar.

words.englishDefinition: A metric unit of length equal to 1000 meters (or 0.621371 miles)
words.japaneseExplanation: 長さのメートル法単位で1000メートル（または0.621371マイル）に同じ。
words.example: How many miles are there in a kilometer?

words.englishDefinition: Around the middle of a scale of evaluation
words.japaneseExplanation: 評価の規模の真ん中の周辺で。
words.example: I would class my garden as medium in size.

words.englishDefinition: A metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
words.japaneseExplanation: 1キログラムの1000分の1と同等の重さの計量単位。
words.example: I would like 500 grams of meat please.

words.englishDefinition: One of two equal parts of a divisible whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 割り切れる全体の2等分の1。
words.example: I ate lunch two and a half hours ago.

words.englishDefinition: between noon and midnight
words.japaneseExplanation: 午後を表す時刻の表記。午後三時は three p.m.。
words.example: The library closes at six p.m. on Fridays.

words.englishDefinition: between midnight and noon
words.japaneseExplanation: 午前を表す時刻の表記。午前九時は nine a.m.。
words.example: My first class starts at nine a.m. tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: connected with younger people or a lower school level
words.japaneseExplanation: 年齢や学年が低いことを表す。junior high school は中学校。
words.example: My sister starts junior high school next year.

words.englishDefinition: about the subject named in an email heading
words.japaneseExplanation: メールの件名で「〜について」を示す表記。返信メールにも付く。
words.example: The subject of her email was Re: School Trip.

words.englishDefinition: Be familiar or acquainted with a person or an object
words.japaneseExplanation: ある人や物に馴染み深く、知っている。
words.example: I really do want to get to know you better.

words.englishDefinition: Make visible or noticeable
words.japaneseExplanation: 見えるか、または目立たせる。
words.example: Please show me that one in the window over there.

words.englishDefinition: Come upon, as if by accident; meet with
words.japaneseExplanation: まるで偶然かのように、出会う。会う。
words.example: I don't want to find you here when I come back.

words.englishDefinition: Gain knowledge or skills
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識または能力を獲得する。
words.example: I wish I could learn every language in the world.

words.englishDefinition: Clean with some chemical process
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの化学過程で浄化する。
words.example: I think it's time for me to wash my car.

words.englishDefinition: A period of time containing 365 (or 366) days
words.japaneseExplanation: 365日間（または366日間）。
words.example: I go to Boston three or four times a year.

words.englishDefinition: Clock time
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間。
words.example: Our train was an hour late because of the heavy snow.

words.englishDefinition: The specified day of the month
words.japaneseExplanation: 月の特定の日。
words.example: What is the date today?

words.englishDefinition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
words.japaneseExplanation: 60秒または1/60時間と等しい時間の単位。
words.example: I had hardly waited a minute when he came.

words.englishDefinition: A particular point in time
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の時点。
words.example: What time is it at the moment in your country?

words.englishDefinition: The middle of the day
words.japaneseExplanation: 真っ昼間。
words.example: We have lunch at noon every day.

words.englishDefinition: An organization to gain political power
words.japaneseExplanation: 政権を獲得する組織。
words.example: I wish I could go to the party with you.

words.englishDefinition: An amusement or pastime
words.japaneseExplanation: 楽しみ、または気晴らし。
words.example: I thought that a game of tennis might be fun.

words.englishDefinition: Searching for or buying goods or services
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品やサービスを探したり買ったりすること。
words.example: I drove to town and went shopping.

words.englishDefinition: Something presented as a gift
words.japaneseExplanation: 贈呈されるもの。
words.example: I want a present for my wife.

words.englishDefinition: Widely known and esteemed
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く知られ、尊重される。
words.example: I wonder what it would be like to be famous.

words.englishDefinition: Delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚を活気づけ、知的情緒的賞賛を喚起する。
words.example: What is more beautiful than the smile of a child?

words.englishDefinition: At or within a short distance in space or time or having elements near each other
words.japaneseExplanation: 空間にせよ時間にせよ短い距離か短い距離内にある、あるいは要素が互いに近くにある。
words.example: How close to each other were you standing?

words.englishDefinition: with many clouds in the sky
words.japaneseExplanation: 空が雲に覆われていること。
words.example: It was cloudy this morning, but now it's sunny.

words.englishDefinition: Obviously contrived to charm
words.japaneseExplanation: 明らかにうまく魅了する。
words.example: I wish there were some cute guys in my class.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who is licensed to operate an aircraft in flight
words.japaneseExplanation: 飛行中に航空機を操縦するのを認可されている誰か。
words.example: I have a friend who is a pilot.

words.englishDefinition: A salesperson in a store
words.japaneseExplanation: 店の販売員。
words.example: The salesclerk will come to help you right away.

words.englishDefinition: A person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences
words.japaneseExplanation: 一分野以上の科学の高度な知識を持つ人。
words.example: You know, I'm something of a scientist myself.

words.englishDefinition: A male sovereign; ruler of a kingdom
words.japaneseExplanation: 男性の君主。王国の支配者。
words.example: I have no idea why the king kept them around.

words.englishDefinition: The part of the body between the neck and the upper arm
words.japaneseExplanation: 首と上腕の間の身体部分。
words.example: What does the doctor think is wrong with your shoulder?

words.englishDefinition: a woman who serves food and drinks in a restaurant
words.japaneseExplanation: 飲食店で料理や飲み物を運ぶ女性。性別を問わない語は server。
words.example: The waitress brought us some water and menus.

words.englishDefinition: A performer who dances professionally
words.japaneseExplanation: ダンスを見せる人。
words.example: How can we tell the dancer from the dance?

words.englishDefinition: A person qualified to practice dentistry
words.japaneseExplanation: 歯科医を開業する資格を持つ人。
words.example: I have to go to the dentist after school today.

words.englishDefinition: A visitor to whom hospitality is extended
words.japaneseExplanation: もてなしを受ける訪問者。
words.example: Can you tell me where I can find a guest house?

words.englishDefinition: A person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)
words.japaneseExplanation: （レストランなどで）給仕をする仕事の人。
words.example: I asked the waiter to see about getting us a better table.

words.englishDefinition: A domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement
words.japaneseExplanation: 慰み用・愛玩用に飼い慣らされた動物。
words.example: My dog was more than just a pet to me.

words.englishDefinition: A plumbing fixture that sprays water over you
words.japaneseExplanation: 水をまき散らすために配管され取り付られた具。
words.example: You can take a shower in the upstairs bathroom.

words.englishDefinition: A digital recording (as of a movie) on an optical disk that can be played on a computer or a television set
words.japaneseExplanation: コンピュータまたはテレビで再生されることができる光ディスクの（映画のようなものの）デジタル記憶媒体。
words.example: I wish I could figure out how to burn a DVD.

words.englishDefinition: Electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い距離を転送されることができる音を電子信号に変換し、その後受信信号を音に再度変換する電子機器。
words.example: I talked with him about it over the telephone.

words.englishDefinition: A brittle transparent solid with irregular atomic structure
words.japaneseExplanation: 不規則な原子構造をもった砕けやすい透明な固体。
words.example: Could you get me a glass of ice water, please?

words.englishDefinition: A periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to those who purchase it or subscribe to it
words.japaneseExplanation: 購入、または定期購読する人にとって興味深い写真、小説、および記事を掲載する定期刊行物。
words.example: We will not add more pictures to our magazine.

words.englishDefinition: Kitchen appliance used for baking or roasting
words.japaneseExplanation: ベーキングまたはローストのために使われる台所機器。
words.example: I took the cake out of the oven too early.

words.englishDefinition: A room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet
words.japaneseExplanation: 浴槽またはシャワーと通常洗面台とトイレを含んでいる部屋（住居のように）。
words.example: My apartment has a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen and a bathroom.

words.englishDefinition: An upholstered seat for more than one person
words.japaneseExplanation: 二人以上の人のための布張りをした席。
words.example: How many does the sofa seat?

words.englishDefinition: A tabular array of the days (usually for one year)
words.japaneseExplanation: 日にちの表配列（通常は1年間）。
words.example: I bought a calendar for next year at the store.

words.englishDefinition: Come or bring to a finish or an end
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕上げるあるうは終わりにくるあるいはそれをもたらす。
words.example: I will finish it by the time he comes back.

words.englishDefinition: Deliver by singing
words.japaneseExplanation: 歌うことで述べる。
words.example: I wish I could sing as well as you do.

words.englishDefinition: Any object of warm affection or devotion
words.japaneseExplanation: 熱烈な愛情や献身の対象。
words.example: I immediately knew he was the love of my life.

words.englishDefinition: Put into a certain place or abstract location
words.japaneseExplanation: ある一定の場所または抽象的な場所に置く。
words.example: We need to find a safe place to put this.

words.englishDefinition: Move out of or depart from
words.japaneseExplanation: 出て行く、または立ち去る。
words.example: I turned out the light and left the room.

words.englishDefinition: A hallucinatory experience induced by drugs
words.japaneseExplanation: 麻薬によって生じる幻覚的経験。
words.example: We have just returned from a trip around the world.

words.englishDefinition: A day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration
words.japaneseExplanation: 祝宴と祝賀のためにとっておいた日または時間。
words.example: I hope that people will come to our festival.

words.englishDefinition: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 労働を離れた余暇時間で、休息または娯楽に用いられる。
words.example: I can't remember the last time I took a vacation.

words.englishDefinition: a show that you watch on television
words.japaneseExplanation: テレビで放送される番組。British English では programme とも書く。
words.example: My favorite TV program starts at eight tonight.

words.englishDefinition: Temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
words.japaneseExplanation: 臨時の生活宿舎で特に軍隊によって兵士用に建てられたもの。
words.example: I went out on a camping trip.

words.englishDefinition: Undertake a journey or trip
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅または旅行を経験する。
words.example: I wonder what it is like to travel through space.

words.englishDefinition: Equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)
words.japaneseExplanation: 写真を撮るための装置（通常、片端にレンズがついた遮光ボックスと、もう一方には感光膜から成る）。
words.example: I forgot to put film in the camera.

words.englishDefinition: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 労働を離れた余暇時間で、休息または娯楽に用いられる。
words.example: We want to have our holiday on an island this summer.

words.englishDefinition: Something acquired without compensation
words.japaneseExplanation: 保証なしで得られる何か。
words.example: My gift is in the car. I'll get it now.

words.englishDefinition: The mother of your father or mother
words.japaneseExplanation: 父あるいは母の母親。
words.example: My mother is my grandmother.

words.englishDefinition: Limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 数、量、大きさまたは範囲が制限された、あるいは平均以下の。
words.example: I think that car is a little too small for you.

words.englishDefinition: Limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 数、量、大きさまたは範囲が制限された、あるいは平均以下の。
words.example: I think that car is a little too small for you.

words.englishDefinition: Arousing or holding the attention
words.japaneseExplanation: 注意を喚起または保持する。
words.example: I think a film is more interesting than any book.

words.englishDefinition: (of weather) wet by periods of rain
words.japaneseExplanation: （天気の）雨の周期による湿気。
words.example: Do you go to school by bus on rainy days?

words.englishDefinition: Experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness
words.japaneseExplanation: 悲しみまたは不幸を経験するか、示すさま。
words.example: I felt sad and you were far away.

words.englishDefinition: Medium for communication
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報伝達のメディア。
words.example: Do you listen to the radio at home every day?

words.englishDefinition: One or more recordings issued together; originally released on 12-inch phonograph records (usually with attractive record covers) and later on cassette audiotape and compact disc
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に発行されたひとつ以上のレコード。元々、12インチのレコード（通常魅力的なレコード・カバーで）で、それ以降カセット録音テープとコンパクトディスクでリリースされる。
words.example: I decided to share the album with my family later.

words.englishDefinition: A room used primarily for sleeping
words.japaneseExplanation: 主として眠るための部屋。
words.example: I said that this was a meeting room, not a bedroom!

words.englishDefinition: two thin sticks used together for eating
words.japaneseExplanation: 食事に使う二本の箸。a pair of chopsticks で一膳。
words.example: Can you show me how to use chopsticks?

words.englishDefinition: Small brush; has long handle; used to clean teeth
words.japaneseExplanation: 小筆。長い柄がある。
words.example: I clean my teeth with a toothbrush.

words.englishDefinition: The act of preparing something (as food) by the application of heat
words.japaneseExplanation: 熱を加えることによって（食べ物のような）何かを用意する行為。
words.example: My wife does the cooking and I wash the dishes.

words.englishDefinition: A beverage made from cocoa powder and milk and sugar; usually drunk hot
words.japaneseExplanation: ココア粉とミルクと砂糖から作られる飲料。通常暖かくして飲む。
words.example: I made myself a cup of hot chocolate.

words.englishDefinition: Dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top
words.japaneseExplanation: 上面に練り粉をつけ、練り粉の皮を敷いた皿で焼いたもの。
words.example: You can have the rest of the pie.

words.englishDefinition: Edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant
words.japaneseExplanation: 多数の草本植物の食用の種、根、茎、葉、球根、塊茎、あるいは甘くない果実。
words.example: You wash the vegetables and I'll wash the fruit.

words.englishDefinition: Food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed and served with a moist dressing; usually consisting of or including greens
words.japaneseExplanation: いろいろなものを皿に盛り付けたり混ぜ合わせたりしてドレッシングを添える料理。通常、緑黄色野菜から成る、または、緑黄色野菜を含む。
words.example: How much does it cost to make a salad?

words.englishDefinition: Pasta in the form of long strings
words.japaneseExplanation: 長いひも状のパスタ。
words.example: Could you pass the spaghetti?

words.englishDefinition: Meat from an adult domestic bovine
words.japaneseExplanation: 成熟した家畜牛の肉。
words.example: Do you have a beef with me?

words.englishDefinition: Mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable
words.japaneseExplanation: 赤や黄の果肉質のややすっぱい野菜。
words.example: I became as red as a tomato.

words.englishDefinition: The flesh of a chicken used for food
words.japaneseExplanation: 食用の鶏肉。
words.example: I like the cats but the chicken is better.

words.englishDefinition: A dish served as the last course of a meal
words.japaneseExplanation: 食事の最後として出される一品。
words.example: My son didn't finish the dessert, so I ate it.

words.englishDefinition: A light informal meal
words.japaneseExplanation: 気軽な軽食。
words.example: I had a snack before I went back to work.

words.englishDefinition: Food prepared by stewing especially meat or fish with vegetables
words.japaneseExplanation: 肉や魚と野菜をとろ火で煮た料理。
words.example: I will go to buy the meat for the stew.

words.englishDefinition: A sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients
words.japaneseExplanation: 牛の挽肉を揚げたものを柔らかいパンにのせたもの。
words.example: I stopped for a hamburger on the way home.

words.englishDefinition: The bulb of an onion plant
words.japaneseExplanation: タマネギの球根。
words.example: How can you cut an onion without crying?

words.englishDefinition: Highly seasoned minced meat stuffed in casings
words.japaneseExplanation: 細かく切った肉に香料をたっぷりときかせ、皮に詰めたもの。
words.example: I wonder how the sausage is made.

words.englishDefinition: Take in liquids
words.japaneseExplanation: 液体を中に入れる。
words.example: You have to drink enough water each day.

words.englishDefinition: Take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 自らで、何かまたは誰かをどこかへ連れて行く。
words.example: Please bring me a chair from the next room.

words.englishDefinition: Be the cause or source of
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの原因または源となる。
words.example: Could you please give me a piece of information?

words.englishDefinition: Stay in one place and anticipate or expect something
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つの場所にとどまり、何かを予想する、または期待する。
words.example: I had to wait for him for five hours!

words.englishDefinition: Judge or regard; look upon; judge
words.japaneseExplanation: 判断する、または考える。見なす。
words.example: I wonder if he will think of that by himself?

words.englishDefinition: The brother of your father or mother; the husband of your aunt
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたの父または母の兄弟。あなたの叔母の夫。
words.example: My uncle is the brother of my mother.

words.englishDefinition: (plural) any group of human beings (men or women or children) collectively
words.japaneseExplanation: （複数形）集合的に人間（男や女、または子供たち）のグループ。
words.example: I don't think any of the people over there are women.

words.englishDefinition: A male human offspring
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の男の子。
words.example: My son is not at home, he is at school.

words.englishDefinition: A female human offspring
words.japaneseExplanation: 女性の子供。
words.example: I have a daughter the same age as your son.

words.englishDefinition: A licensed medical practitioner
words.japaneseExplanation: 認可された医者。
words.example: I feel very bad, I must see a doctor.

words.englishDefinition: The principal activity in your life that you do to earn money
words.japaneseExplanation: 金銭を稼ぐために行う生活の中での主要な活動。
words.example: Do you think he did the job on his own?

words.englishDefinition: more than one child
words.japaneseExplanation: child の複数形。「子どもたち」の意味。
words.example: The children are playing outside after lunch.

words.englishDefinition: The sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle
words.japaneseExplanation: 父や母の姉妹。おじの妻。
words.example: My aunt was like a real mother to me.

words.englishDefinition: The father of your father or mother
words.japaneseExplanation: 父あるいは母の父親。
words.example: You look more like your grandfather than your father.

words.japanese: 一員、会員、部員、メンバー
words.englishDefinition: Anything that belongs to a set or class
words.japaneseExplanation: ある集合または種別に属するもの。
words.example: How long have you been a member of this group?

words.englishDefinition: Primarily temporal sense; indicating or being or seeming to be limited in duration
words.japaneseExplanation: 主に一時的な感覚。期間の制限を示している、である、あるいは、のように見える。
words.example: I would like to share a short story with you.

words.englishDefinition: not good or pleasant
words.japaneseExplanation: 質や状態がよくないこと。
words.example: The weather was bad, so we stayed home.

words.japanese: 一生懸命に、難しい、硬い
words.englishDefinition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡単でない。完成させ、理解しまたは我慢する物理的または精神的努力を必要とする。
words.example: I know this has been a hard time for you.

words.englishDefinition: Having or producing a comfortable and agreeable degree of heat or imparting or maintaining heat
words.japaneseExplanation: 心地よく快適な温度を有するか生み出す、または、熱を与えるか維持する。
words.example: We will keep the room warm.

words.englishDefinition: Regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に一般大衆によってとても好かれ、受け入れられ、愛されている。
words.example: I am a popular girl at school.

words.englishDefinition: A slice of meat cut from the fleshy part of an animal or large fish
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物か大きい魚の肉の部分から切られた1切れの肉。
words.example: Do you not enjoy the steak at this English restaurant?

words.englishDefinition: a large fruit with a green skin and red or pink flesh
words.japaneseExplanation: 外側は緑色で、中が赤色や桃色の果物のスイカ。
words.example: Let's have some cold watermelon after lunch.

words.englishDefinition: A compound formed by replacing hydrogen in an acid by a metal (or a radical that acts like a metal)
words.japaneseExplanation: 金属により酸の中で水素を取り替えることによって形成される合成物（または金属のようなふりをするラジカル）。
words.example: Can you pass me the salt from the table?

words.englishDefinition: An edible emulsion of fat globules made by churning milk or cream; for cooking and table use
words.japaneseExplanation: 牛乳またはクリームをかき回して作る、食用の脂肪球の乳状液。調理または食卓で使用する。
words.example: I need some butter. Do you have any?

words.englishDefinition: A white crystalline carbohydrate used as a sweetener and preservative
words.japaneseExplanation: 甘味料・保存剤として使う白い結晶状の炭水化物。
words.example: Can you buy some sugar on your way home?

words.englishDefinition: Any of many shrubs of the genus Rosa that bear roses
words.japaneseExplanation: バラの花をつけるバラ属の多くの低木。
words.example: How long have you looked after this rose garden?

words.englishDefinition: a very large mammal that lives in the sea
words.japaneseExplanation: 海に住む大きな哺乳類のクジラ。魚ではない。
words.example: We saw a whale from the boat yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: a sea mammal with a long body and a pointed mouth
words.japaneseExplanation: 海に住む哺乳類のイルカ。
words.example: A dolphin swam close to our boat.

words.englishDefinition: a very large animal with a long trunk
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い鼻と大きな体を持つ動物のゾウ。
words.example: The elephant picked up some food with its trunk.

words.englishDefinition: Short-tailed Old World burrowing rodent with large cheek pouches
words.japaneseExplanation: 旧世界産の大きなほお袋を持つ短い尾の穴居性の齧歯動物。
words.example: We can't have a hamster because we have cats.

words.englishDefinition: Short-legged flightless birds of cold southern especially Antarctic regions having webbed feet and wings modified as flippers
words.japaneseExplanation: 水かきのある足とフリッパーとして変化した翼がある寒冷の南部特に南極地方の短い脚の飛べない鳥。
words.example: I am a native speaker of the penguin language.

words.englishDefinition: Any of numerous perennial bulbous herbs having linear or broadly lanceolate leaves and usually a single showy flower
words.japaneseExplanation: 線形のまたは広い披針形の葉と通常ただ1つの華やかな花を持つ多数の多年生の球根草本の総称。
words.example: I look at your beautiful tulip.

words.englishDefinition: A young dog
words.japaneseExplanation: 小犬。
words.example: I have had this dog since she was a puppy.

words.englishDefinition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of
words.japaneseExplanation: 呼吸に必要な気体の混合物（特に酸素）。風ができるもの。
words.example: What do I need to get some air for?

words.englishDefinition: Solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times
words.japaneseExplanation: 先史時代から家畜化されている、蹄のある草食性の四肢動物。
words.example: I have brought here only my clothes and my horse.

words.englishDefinition: The natural satellite of the Earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の天然衛星。
words.example: We learned that the moon goes around the earth.

words.englishDefinition: A performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging
words.japaneseExplanation: 演奏家、歌手による演劇を含まない音楽の演奏。
words.example: I would like to go to the concert with you.

words.englishDefinition: Instrumentalists not including string players
words.japaneseExplanation: 弦楽器奏者を含まない器楽家達。
words.example: I liked that band better before they became popular.

words.englishDefinition: A musical percussion instrument; usually consists of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across each end
words.japaneseExplanation: 打楽器。通常、どちらかの側まで引き伸ばされた膜がある中空円筒から成る。
words.example: We saw the drum set at the store.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various devices or contrivances that can be used to produce musical tones or sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 音楽を演奏するための道具の総称。
words.example: I don't know how to play an instrument.

words.englishDefinition: React verbally
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で反応する。
words.example: What kind of questions do you want me to answer?

words.englishDefinition: Hear with intention
words.japaneseExplanation: 注意して聞く。
words.example: I tried to tell her, but she refused to listen.

words.englishDefinition: Express in words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で表現する。
words.example: Can you make out what he is trying to say?

words.englishDefinition: Express in speech
words.japaneseExplanation: スピーチで表す。
words.example: Do you know whether or not she can speak English?

words.englishDefinition: Impart skills or knowledge to
words.japaneseExplanation: 技能か知識を分け与える。
words.example: I can teach you French if you want me to.

words.englishDefinition: A person who performs voluntary work
words.japaneseExplanation: ボランティア労働に従事する人。
words.example: I have a friend who works as a volunteer.

words.englishDefinition: more than one tooth
words.japaneseExplanation: tooth の複数形。食べ物をかむための歯。
words.example: I brush my teeth before I go to bed.

words.englishDefinition: A person who operates a farm
words.japaneseExplanation: 農場を経営する人。
words.example: I should have become a farmer like my father wanted.

words.englishDefinition: The front of the human head from the forehead to the chin and ear to ear
words.japaneseExplanation: 額から顎、耳から耳までの人頭の前部。
words.example: You should have seen her face when I said that.

words.englishDefinition: A covering for the body (or parts of it) consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures (as on the human head); helps to prevent heat loss
words.japaneseExplanation: 糸状構造物（人間の頭の上で）の高密度増殖からなる体（またはその部分）の覆い。熱の損失を防ぐのを助ける。
words.example: I changed my hair, but he didn't like it.

words.englishDefinition: The visible part of a television transmission
words.japaneseExplanation: テレビ放送の見える部分。
words.example: Could you take a picture of me and my friends?

words.englishDefinition: A machine for performing calculations automatically
words.japaneseExplanation: 自動的に計算を行う機械。
words.example: We are looking for somebody who can use a computer.

words.englishDefinition: A keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 鍵盤を押し下げるとハンマーが調律された弦をたたいて音を出す、という仕組みで演奏される鍵盤楽器。
words.example: My sister can play the piano better than I can.

words.englishDefinition: A room equipped for preparing meals
words.japaneseExplanation: 食事を用意するための部屋。
words.example: My apartment has a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen and a bathroom.

words.englishDefinition: A daily or weekly publication on folded sheets; contains news and articles and advertisements
words.japaneseExplanation: 折り畳まれた紙に書かれた日刊または週刊の出版物。ニュース、記事、広告を含む。
words.example: I think he doesn't want you to read the newspaper.

words.englishDefinition: Acting or moving or capable of acting or moving quickly
words.japaneseExplanation: 迅速に作用すること、動くことあるいは、作用することと動くことが可能である。
words.example: I have to set my watch back. It's very fast.

words.englishDefinition: Above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: サイズ、数、量、大きさまたは範囲において平均以上の。
words.example: I have no wish to live in a large city.

words.englishDefinition: Extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に良い、または大きい。特に強意語として使用される。
words.example: I had a wonderful time when I was in Boston.

words.englishDefinition: Not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied
words.japaneseExplanation: 既に述べた、または示したのと同じものではない。
words.example: I still haven't eaten the chocolate that you gave me the other day.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by the presence of snow
words.japaneseExplanation: 雪の存在によって特徴のある。
words.example: I remember that it was winter because it was really cold and snowy.

words.englishDefinition: A brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone; has a narrow tube and a flared bell and is played by means of valves
words.japaneseExplanation: 鮮やかなトーンのある金管楽器。細い管とフレアーのベルがあり、バルブの方法で演奏される。
words.example: I used to be able to play the trumpet.

words.englishDefinition: A single-reed instrument with a straight tube
words.japaneseExplanation: 真っ直ぐな管をもつシングルリードの楽器。
words.example: I haven't played the clarinet for a long time.

words.englishDefinition: A play or film whose action and dialogue is interspersed with singing and dancing
words.japaneseExplanation: 歌と踊りを交えた動作や会話が特徴の演劇あるいは映画作品。
words.example: I can play the musical paper for you.

words.englishDefinition: An outer garment that has sleeves and covers the body from shoulder down; worn outdoors
words.japaneseExplanation: 袖を持ち肩から下に向けて体を覆う外側の衣服。屋外で着られる。
words.example: You must take your coat, in case it gets cold.

words.englishDefinition: things worn on your feet when you walk outside
words.japaneseExplanation: 足を保護する靴。a pair of shoes で一足。
words.example: Please take off your shoes at the door.

words.englishDefinition: A one-piece garment for a woman; has skirt and bodice
words.japaneseExplanation: 婦人用のワンピース。スカートと胴着の部分がある。
words.example: We came here to buy a dress for our daughter.

words.englishDefinition: pieces of clothing worn on the feet inside shoes
words.japaneseExplanation: 靴の中にはく靴下。a pair of socks で一足。
words.example: I need some clean socks for school tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: The attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball
words.japaneseExplanation: 劇や仮装舞踏会で身につける服装。
words.example: I know I look like a gift box in this costume.

words.englishDefinition: Jewelry consisting of a circlet of precious metal (often set with jewels) worn on the finger
words.japaneseExplanation: 指につけられる貴金属（しばしば宝石と一緒に）の輪で成る宝石。
words.example: You must return the ring to where it came from.

words.englishDefinition: A garment hanging from the waist; worn mainly by girls and women
words.japaneseExplanation: ウエストからさがっている衣服。主に少女と婦人が着用する。
words.example: I really like this skirt. Can I try it on?

words.englishDefinition: A crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body
words.japaneseExplanation: 上体を覆うかぎ針編みあるいはメリヤスの衣服。
words.example: I think that this sweater will look good on you.

words.englishDefinition: Neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn (mostly by men) under a collar and tied in knot at the front
words.japaneseExplanation: （たいてい男子によって）カラーの下に付けられ前で結ばれる一枚の小幅の長い生地。
words.example: I wore this tie yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: A state in the United States in the central Pacific on the Hawaiian Islands
words.japaneseExplanation: 太平洋中央のハワイ島を占める米国の州。
words.example: I am going to spend this weekend in Hawaii.

words.englishDefinition: A republic in southern Europe on the Italian Peninsula; was the core of the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire between the 4th century BC and the 5th century AD
words.japaneseExplanation: イタリアの半島の南ヨーロッパの共和国。ローマ共和国とローマ帝国の中心は、紀元前4世紀と西暦5世紀の間にあった。
words.example: I go to visit my family in Italy once a year.

words.englishDefinition: Largest city in Illinois; a bustling Great Lakes port that extends 26 miles along the southwestern shoreline of Lake Michigan
words.japaneseExplanation: イリノイ最大の都市。ミシガン湖南西岸沿いに26マイル伸びる騒がしい五大湖の港。
words.example: I stayed in Chicago over two months.

words.englishDefinition: A parliamentary monarchy in southwestern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula; a former colonial power
words.japaneseExplanation: ヨーロッパ南西部のイベリア半島に面した議会制君主国。かつての植民地大国。
words.example: I have a friend in Spain who speaks five languages.

words.englishDefinition: A country of southeastern Asia that extends southward along the Isthmus of Kra to the Malay Peninsula
words.japaneseExplanation: クラ地峡に沿ってマレー半島まで南方に及ぶ、南東アジアの国。
words.example: I want you to visit us in Thailand!

words.englishDefinition: A game played on a large open course with 9 or 18 holes; the object is use as few strokes as possible in playing all the holes
words.japaneseExplanation: 9または18ホールの広い屋外のコースで行われるゲーム。目的はできるだけ少ない打数ですべてのホールを回ること。
words.example: I live close to a golf course.

words.englishDefinition: Skating on ice
words.japaneseExplanation: 氷の上をスケートで滑ること。
words.example: I go ice skating every chance that I get.

words.englishDefinition: A game played on a court with light long-handled rackets used to volley a shuttlecock over a net
words.japaneseExplanation: シャトルをネットの向こう側に発射するために柄の長いラケットを使ってコート上でプレイされるゲーム。
words.example: I think that badminton is more fun than tennis.

words.englishDefinition: Be dressed in
words.japaneseExplanation: 身に付けている。
words.example: What are you going to wear to the party tonight?

words.englishDefinition: Perceive (sound) via the auditory sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 聴覚の感覚を経て（音）に気づく。
words.example: I just wanted to hear the sound of your voice.

words.englishDefinition: Express in words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で表現する。
words.example: Can you please tell me what time the train leaves?

words.englishDefinition: Put an end to a state or an activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 状態または活動に終止符を打つ。
words.example: Please put a full stop at the end of the sentence.

words.englishDefinition: Enter or assume a certain state or condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の状態または状態になる、あるいはとみなす。
words.example: I think you two are going to become good friends.

words.englishDefinition: A written message addressed to a person or organization
words.japaneseExplanation: 人または組織に宛てた書かれたメッセージ。
words.example: I had just written the letter when he came back.

words.englishDefinition: a message sent electronically over the internet
words.japaneseExplanation: インターネットを使って送る電子メール。email とも書く。
words.example: Please send me an e-mail with the meeting details.

words.englishDefinition: A set of data arranged in rows and columns
words.japaneseExplanation: 行と列に配置されたデータの組。
words.example: I looked under the table to see what was there.

words.englishDefinition: Electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い距離を転送されることができる音を電子信号に変換し、その後受信信号を音に再度変換する電子機器。
words.example: I didn't want to talk about that over the phone.

words.englishDefinition: An implement that has hairs or bristles firmly set into a handle
words.japaneseExplanation: 毛または剛毛が取手に堅くつけられている道具。
words.example: I felt the brush of her hand against me.

words.englishDefinition: A swinging or sliding barrier that will close the entrance to a room or building or vehicle
words.japaneseExplanation: 部屋または建物または車の入り口を閉鎖するだろう揺れるかまたは滑っている柵。
words.example: Please will you close the door when you go out.

words.englishDefinition: Metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated
words.japaneseExplanation: 錠に差し込んだとき錠前のメカニズムが回転するように型取られた金属器具。
words.example: I must have lost my key along the way.

words.englishDefinition: A recording of both the visual and audible components (especially one containing a recording of a movie or television program)
words.japaneseExplanation: 映像部分と音声部分の両方の記録媒体（特に映画またはテレビ番組の記録媒体を含んでいるもの）。
words.example: I like that video game. And only that video game.

words.englishDefinition: a large container that you fill with water to wash your body
words.japaneseExplanation: 体を洗ったり温めたりするための浴槽。
words.example: There is a large bath in the hotel room.

words.englishDefinition: A framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air
words.japaneseExplanation: 壁や天井に採光や通風のために作られた、ガラスのはまった木や金属の枠組み。
words.example: I opened the window to let in some fresh air.

words.englishDefinition: Being of use or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 役に立つことまたは奉仕。
words.example: I feel very useful in my own job position.

words.englishDefinition: very pleasant to taste
words.japaneseExplanation: 食べ物や飲み物の味がとてもよいこと。
words.example: This soup is delicious. Can I have some more?

words.englishDefinition: Creating or arousing excitement
words.japaneseExplanation: 興奮を生み出すこと、または喚起するさま。
words.example: I had never seen such an exciting baseball game before.

words.englishDefinition: Belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の人（とくにあなた自身）のために、またはそれに属する。所有格によって先行される。
words.example: Do you make your own clothes?

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by an absence or near absence of agitation or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 困惑または行動の欠如またはほぼ欠如することによって特徴づけられる。
words.example: I came out here to enjoy some peace and quiet.

words.englishDefinition: The sport of traveling on a bicycle or motorcycle
words.japaneseExplanation: 自転車かオートバイで移動するスポーツ。
words.example: You may go cycling if it doesn't rain.

words.englishDefinition: A game resembling ice hockey that is played on an open field; two opposing teams use curved sticks try to drive a ball into the opponents' net
words.japaneseExplanation: フィールドで行われるアイスホッケーに類似しているゲーム。2つの相対するチームが曲がったスティックを使って相手側のネットにボールをたたき込む。
words.example: I heard that you bought a hockey team.

words.englishDefinition: Running at a jog trot as a form of cardiopulmonary exercise
words.japaneseExplanation: 心肺運動の形のようなジョッグトロットのランニング。
words.example: I go jogging every morning before I go to school.

words.englishDefinition: Place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業上であるか事務員の義務が実行される勤務地。
words.example: I have important business to take care of in my office.

words.englishDefinition: A commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)
words.japaneseExplanation: 保有者が何らかの（公共輸送機関に乗るか、一般向けの娯楽｛ごらくのような）権利があることを示している商業的な文書。
words.example: Please give me a ticket for the seven o'clock show.

words.englishDefinition: The general activity of selling
words.japaneseExplanation: 販売の一般的な活動。
words.example: I got it for half price at a sale.

words.englishDefinition: The side that is seen or that goes first
words.japaneseExplanation: 最初に見られる、または最初に行く側。
words.example: I like to sit in the front of the bus.

words.englishDefinition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region
words.japaneseExplanation: より大きなものの内部の、ほぼ真ん中にある領域。
words.example: What train goes to the center of town?

words.englishDefinition: A formation of people or things one behind another
words.japaneseExplanation: 順々に後ろに並ぶ人や物の編成。
words.example: You must stand in a line to buy a ticket.

words.englishDefinition: A card for sending messages by post without an envelope
words.japaneseExplanation: 封筒に入れずに郵便でメッセージを送るためのカード。
words.example: I forgot to send the kids a postcard from Algeria.

words.englishDefinition: A ceremonial procession including people marching
words.japaneseExplanation: 行進する人々を含む儀式的な行列。
words.example: I couldn't see the parade well from where I was.

words.englishDefinition: A document issued by a country to a citizen allowing that person to travel abroad and re-enter the home country
words.japaneseExplanation: 国から市民に発行される文書で、外国を旅行し自国に戻ることを許可する。
words.example: You absolutely need a passport to travel to a foreign country.

words.englishDefinition: A sign posted in a public place as an advertisement
words.japaneseExplanation: 広告として公共の場所に貼られた掲示。
words.example: What does that poster mean?

words.englishDefinition: The property of having material worth (often indicated by the amount of money something would bring if sold)
words.japaneseExplanation: 物質的な価値をもつという特質（しばしば、何かが売られたときにもたらす金額によって表される）。
words.example: I wonder if this is worth the price they're asking.

words.englishDefinition: The top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの頂点または極点（通常山または丘）。
words.example: We could not see the top of the mountain.

words.englishDefinition: The distance covered by a step
words.japaneseExplanation: 1歩で行く距離。
words.example: You need to take a step back and check yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Something done (usually as opposed to something said)
words.japaneseExplanation: なされた事柄（通常、言われた事柄に対して言う）。
words.example: I invited Gustavo to watch an action movie with me.

words.englishDefinition: The style in which hair has been cut
words.japaneseExplanation: 髪を切ったスタイル。
words.example: My hair is too long already, so I'm going for a haircut.

words.englishDefinition: The arrangement of the hair (especially a woman's hair)
words.japaneseExplanation: 髪（特に女性の髪）のアレンジメント。
words.example: I wanted to change things up with my hairstyle.

words.englishDefinition: Your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)
words.japaneseExplanation: 人生（あなたに起こるすべてを含んでいる）におけるあなたの総合的な事情か状態。
words.example: I wish you all the luck in the world.

words.englishDefinition: Make an effort or attempt
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力する、または試みる。
words.example: I told Tom he should try to do it by himself.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be directed or transmitted to another place
words.japaneseExplanation: 案内される、または別の場所に送信される。
words.example: Please send me a letter as soon as you arrive.

words.englishDefinition: Be asleep
words.japaneseExplanation: 眠っている。
words.example: I wish I could sleep better and fall asleep faster.

words.englishDefinition: Expect and wish
words.japaneseExplanation: 予期し期待する。
words.example: I hope you will come up with a better plan.

words.englishDefinition: Be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
words.japaneseExplanation: 胸を痛める、憂慮している、案じている、問題を抱えている、または不安である。
words.example: I don't think it's anything we need to worry about.

words.englishDefinition: a book or magazine that tells stories through pictures
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵とせりふで物語を伝える漫画や漫画本。
words.example: I borrowed a comic from my friend yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: An artifact designed to be played with
words.japaneseExplanation: 遊ぶために考案された人工品。
words.example: You should ask for help if a toy is broken.

words.englishDefinition: Any solid substance (as opposed to liquid) that is used as a source of nourishment
words.japaneseExplanation: 栄養物として用いられる固形物質（液体に対するものとして）。
words.example: I still have to buy some food for the party.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various small flat sweet cakes ('biscuit' is the British term)
words.japaneseExplanation: 小型で平らな甘い菓子。
words.example: Do you want a cookie or something?

words.englishDefinition: Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
words.japaneseExplanation: 薄いパンの練り粉に香料入りトマトソース・チーズを混ぜたものを塗って焼いたイタリアのオープンパイ。
words.example: I thought that pizza was what you wanted to eat.

words.englishDefinition: Two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them
words.japaneseExplanation: 2枚（またはそれ以上）の薄切りのパンの間に詰め物をしたもの。
words.example: I forgot my lunch and bought a sandwich at school.

words.englishDefinition: the part of a plant, such as an apple, that people often eat
words.japaneseExplanation: リンゴなどの果物。一般的な総称では不可算名詞。
words.example: I usually eat some fruit with my breakfast.

words.englishDefinition: The liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking
words.japaneseExplanation: しぼれるか、料理することによって設備または動物性組織から引き抜かれることができる液体の一部。
words.example: You can drink the juice that's on the table.

words.englishDefinition: A piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常食べ物を乗せたり出したりするのに用いる食器の1つ。
words.example: We might as well eat dog food as eat such a dish.

words.englishDefinition: A beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans
words.japaneseExplanation: 挽いたコーヒー豆の浸出液から成る飲料。
words.example: I always drink my coffee from the same cup.

words.englishDefinition: Ready to fall asleep
words.japaneseExplanation: 今にも眠りそうな。
words.example: I feel sleepy as soon as I finish eating dinner.

words.englishDefinition: every person or thing considered separately
words.japaneseExplanation: 集団の一人一人、一つ一つを個別に表す。
words.example: Each student needs a pencil and a notebook.

words.englishDefinition: (of persons) excessively affected by emotion
words.japaneseExplanation: （人について）過度に感情に影響される。
words.example: I think we're all really excited about this.

words.englishDefinition: the two people or things together
words.japaneseExplanation: 二人または二つの両方を表す。
words.example: Both of my parents enjoy cooking at home.

words.englishDefinition: Devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black
words.japaneseExplanation: 光または明るさが欠けている、または、光または明るさが不十分な。陰になる、または黒い。
