words.example: What happens in the dark always comes to light.

words.englishDefinition: An imaginary creature usually having various human and animal parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 想像上の生き物で、普通は人間や動物の様々な部位からできている。
words.example: I didn't know that you were a monster.

words.englishDefinition: A space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)
words.japaneseExplanation: （劇場、電車、飛行機などで）座るために確保された場所。
words.example: I found myself a seat and sat down.

words.englishDefinition: A small adhesive token stuck on a letter or package to indicate that that postal fees have been paid
words.japaneseExplanation: 郵便の料金が払われたそれを示すために手紙か小包に貼り付けられる小さな粘着性の印。
words.example: I need to get a stamp.

words.englishDefinition: The name of a work of art or literary composition etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 芸術作品または文学作品などの名前。
words.example: I don't remember the title of that movie.

words.englishDefinition: Move in a graceful and rhythmical way
words.japaneseExplanation: 優美でリズミカルに動く。
words.example: I remember the way you used to dance.

words.englishDefinition: Liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food
words.japaneseExplanation: 固形食物を入れた肉、魚、または野菜の煮出し汁からなる液状の食物。
words.example: I like my soup to be warm, not hot.

words.englishDefinition: A red fruit with a single hard stone
words.japaneseExplanation: 硬い種がひとつ入った赤い果物。
words.example: I cut down a cherry tree.

words.englishDefinition: Slices of bread that have been toasted
words.japaneseExplanation: トーストされたパンのスライス。
words.example: I can make some toast if you want.

words.englishDefinition: Food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked
words.japaneseExplanation: 小麦粉またはミールの生地で作られ、通常はイーストまたはベーキングパウダーでふくらまされ、それから焼かれる食物。
words.example: I bought some bread on the way home from work.

words.englishDefinition: The flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food
words.japaneseExplanation: 食料として使われる動物（魚と鳥とカタツムリを含む）の肉。
words.example: You should cut up your meat before you eat it.

words.englishDefinition: A ribbonlike strip of pasta
words.japaneseExplanation: 細いリボン状のパスタ。
words.example: I wish he'd use his noodle every once in a while.

words.englishDefinition: Grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished
words.japaneseExplanation: 食用穀類で、精白しないものや何回か精白するものがある。
words.example: I eat bread more often than I eat rice.

words.englishDefinition: A living organism characterized by voluntary movement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自発的な運動に特徴付けられる、生命を持つ有機体。
words.example: Can you think of an animal that's black and white?

words.englishDefinition: The atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation
words.japaneseExplanation: 温度、風、雲、および降水量の観点から、大気状態を形成する大気条件。
words.example: I played outside with everybody because the weather was good today.

words.englishDefinition: Water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere
words.japaneseExplanation: 大気中で凝縮された水蒸気から成る滴という形での水の落下。
words.example: We have been waiting for the rain to fall.

words.englishDefinition: Located at a great distance in time or space or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間、スペース、程度において非常に距離がある。
words.example: We have far better things to do with our time.

words.englishDefinition: Having or showing interest; especially curiosity or fascination or concern
words.japaneseExplanation: 興味を持つ、または、興味を見せている。特に好奇心または魅惑または懸念。
words.example: I know someone who may be interested in your project.

words.englishDefinition: Being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
words.japaneseExplanation: 明らかに並外れていて予想外であるさま。わずかに奇妙で、若干不思議なほどの。
words.example: What a strange girl she is.

words.englishDefinition: Of so extreme a degree or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 程度や範囲が非常に極端な。
words.example: I really dream of such a tree in my garden.

words.englishDefinition: The syllable naming the fifth (dominant) note of any musical scale in solmization
words.japaneseExplanation: 階名唱法における、音階の5番目（第5度）の音符を指して呼ぶ音節。
words.example: I love her so much that I can't leave her.

words.englishDefinition: Succeed in catching or seizing, especially after a chase
words.japaneseExplanation: 追跡した後に捕獲または捕まえることに成功する。
words.example: We got to the station in time to catch the bus.

words.englishDefinition: Move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分の足を使って、常時地面から片足を上げ、速く動く。
words.example: I was driving too fast and ran off the road.

words.englishDefinition: Descend in free fall under the influence of gravity
words.japaneseExplanation: 重力の影響を受けている時、歯止めなく落下する。
words.example: I could fall in love with you all over again.

words.englishDefinition: Be seated
words.japaneseExplanation: 着席する。
words.example: I got up so an old man could sit in my seat.

words.japanese: チェックする、点検する
words.englishDefinition: Examine so as to determine accuracy, quality, or condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確さ、質、または状態を確かめるために吟味する。
words.example: I think you might want to check this out.

words.englishDefinition: Reproductive organ of angiosperm plants especially one having showy or colorful parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 被子植物の生殖器官で特に目立ったり、あるいはカラフルな部分を持つもの。
words.example: My sister used to take care of the flower bed.

words.englishDefinition: Precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals
words.japaneseExplanation: 氷晶という形で雲から落下する降水。
words.example: I walked through the snow to my place of work.

words.englishDefinition: Binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent
words.japaneseExplanation: 透明で無色、無臭、無味の液体として室温にて起きる二元化合物。摂氏0度未満で氷になり、摂氏100度より上で沸騰する。
words.example: Please give me some ice for the water.

words.englishDefinition: A period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field
words.japaneseExplanation: ある分野で特別の行事または活動が行われる1年の1時期。
words.example: You don't seem to be dressed for the season.

words.englishDefinition: A body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land
words.japaneseExplanation: 陸地に囲まれた（通常塩分を含まない）水域。
words.example: We went through the woods and came to a lake.

words.englishDefinition: A large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)
words.japaneseExplanation: 広い自然の水流（クリークより広い）。
words.example: We went fishing, before the river water became big.

words.englishDefinition: A division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分的に陸に囲まれた大洋や広い海水域の一部分。
words.example: Do you still want to drink water while in the sea?

words.englishDefinition: (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior
words.japaneseExplanation: 内部の熱核反応により生じたエネルギーを放射する、高温のガスでできた天体。
words.example: I want to make you a star here in Algeria.

words.englishDefinition: A lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter
words.japaneseExplanation: 固い統合鉱物質の塊か固まり。
words.example: We found ourselves between a rock and a hard place.

words.englishDefinition: The atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球から見られる大気と宇宙。
words.example: Do you know the reason why the sky looks blue?

words.englishDefinition: In accordance with truth or fact or reality
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実、事実または現実に従って。
words.example: I really don't have time to listen to you right now.

words.englishDefinition: close to someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 距離や時間が近いことを表す。
words.example: There is a small park near my house.

words.englishDefinition: Many times at short intervals
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い間隔で、何回も。
words.example: I often think of the place where we met each other.

words.englishDefinition: At or to or toward the back or rear
words.japaneseExplanation: 後ろあるいは後部で、あるいは、のほうに向かって。
words.example: I went back to the window and looked out.

words.englishDefinition: in a good or skillful way
words.japaneseExplanation: 動作が上手にできることを表す副詞。
words.example: My sister plays the piano very well.

words.englishDefinition: Dismiss from the mind; stop remembering
words.japaneseExplanation: 心から棄却する。覚えることを止める。
words.example: I wouldn't be able to forget you even if I tried.

words.englishDefinition: Come into the company of
words.japaneseExplanation: その仲間に加わる。
words.example: We were thinking of asking you to join our company.

words.englishDefinition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
words.japaneseExplanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
words.example: I ask you to remember this once and for all.

words.englishDefinition: Cause someone or something to move by driving
words.japaneseExplanation: 運転することにより誰かまたは何かを引き起こさせる。
words.example: You will be able to drive a car some day.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to change; make different; cause a transformation
words.japaneseExplanation: 変化させる。変える。
words.example: I think that that's about to change.

words.englishDefinition: Large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male
words.japaneseExplanation: 雄には毛深い鬣のある黄褐色の毛並みを有するアフリカとインドの大きな群生している捕食性の猫科の動物。
words.example: What would you do if you met a lion here?

words.englishDefinition: Any of several fleet black-and-white striped African equines
words.japaneseExplanation: 駿足で黒と白の縞模様を持つ、アフリカ産の各種の馬。
words.example: I had a dream about a zebra.

words.englishDefinition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
words.japaneseExplanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
words.example: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

words.englishDefinition: An artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 構造化され、かつ連続的な楽器あるいは音声から成る聴覚コミュニケーションの芸術的形態。
words.example: We stopped talking so that we could hear the music.

words.englishDefinition: A stringed instrument usually having six strings; played by strumming or plucking
words.japaneseExplanation: 通例6本の弦を持つ弦楽器。かき鳴らすことあるいは爪弾くことで演奏される。
words.example: Do you usually use a pick when you play the guitar?

words.englishDefinition: The particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
words.japaneseExplanation: ある原因によって生み出された特定の聴覚的効果。
words.example: I love the sound of rain on the roof.

words.englishDefinition: A high-pitched woodwind instrument; a slender tube closed at one end with finger holes on one end and an opening near the closed end across which the breath is blown
words.japaneseExplanation: 高音の木管楽器。指穴が一つの端にあり、息を吹き込む開口部が閉じた端の近くにある、交差している一端が閉じている細長い筒。
words.example: I played the flute when I was in high school.

words.japanese: 音楽家、ミュージシャン
words.englishDefinition: Artist who composes or conducts music as a profession
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業として曲を作ったり指揮をしたりする人。
words.example: Do you know when the musician will come here?

words.englishDefinition: A small portable timepiece
words.japaneseExplanation: 小型の携帯用の時計。
words.example: I bought this watch at a small shop in Boston.

words.englishDefinition: A lightweight handheld collapsible canopy
words.japaneseExplanation: 軽い手持ちの折り畳める天蓋。
words.example: You do not have to take your umbrella with you.

words.englishDefinition: In the past
words.japaneseExplanation: 昔は。
words.example: I came to Boston a little over three years ago.

words.englishDefinition: with another person or other people
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかの人と同じ場所で、または協力して行うこと。
words.example: Let's work together to finish this project.

words.englishDefinition: In the near future
words.japaneseExplanation: 近い将来に。
words.example: We should get out of here as soon as possible.

words.englishDefinition: Under normal conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の状態で。
words.example: I don't usually wait for people who show up late.

words.englishDefinition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
words.example: I just did what my boss told me to do.

words.englishDefinition: Change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所を変える。また比喩的にも移動する、旅をするまたは前進する。
words.example: We travel not to move, but to change our mind.

words.englishDefinition: (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion
words.japaneseExplanation: 移動力のない、生命を持つ有機体。
words.example: Can you water the plants in the living room, please?

words.englishDefinition: Move very fast
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に速く動く。
words.example: We have very little time, so please hurry.

words.englishDefinition: Change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば喜びを示すために、唇を広げて表情を変える。
words.example: You ought to smile more often.

words.englishDefinition: Be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious
words.japaneseExplanation: コンテストまたは競争の勝者である。勝利している。
words.example: Our team is likely to win the game.

words.englishDefinition: A garment worn on the upper half of the body
words.japaneseExplanation: 体の上半分に着る衣服。
words.example: I think it's time for me to wash this shirt.

words.englishDefinition: Clothing in general
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般的に衣服。
words.example: My father does not care about his clothes at all.

words.englishDefinition: A visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect
words.japaneseExplanation: それらが放つ、伝導する、あるいは反射する光によって生じる、物の目で見ることのできる属性。
words.example: I like the color white.

words.englishDefinition: A constitutional monarchy occupying the Japanese Archipelago; a world leader in electronics and automobile manufacture and ship building
words.japaneseExplanation: 日本列島を占める立憲君主国。エレクトロニクス、自動車、工業、造船では世界的な牽引国。
words.example: I think that Japan is a very safe country.

words.englishDefinition: A nation in northern North America; the French were the first Europeans to settle in mainland Canada
words.japaneseExplanation: 北アメリカ大陸北部の国。フランス人が本土カナダに定住した最初のヨーロッパ人だった。
words.example: I have been living in Canada for almost five years.

words.englishDefinition: North American republic containing 50 states - 48 conterminous states in North America plus Alaska in northwest North America and the Hawaiian Islands in the Pacific Ocean; achieved independence in 1776
words.japaneseExplanation: 50の州を含むノース・アメリカン共和国−−太平洋の北西の北アメリカとハワイ諸島の北アメリカとアラスカの48の隣接の州。米国には50の州がある。
words.example: I want to stay in America for a few years.

words.englishDefinition: A nation occupying the whole of the Australian continent; Aboriginal tribes are thought to have migrated from southeastern Asia 20,000 years ago; first Europeans were British convicts sent there as a penal colony
words.japaneseExplanation: オーストラリア大陸全体を占める国。20,000年前に東南アジアから移住したと考えられているアボリジニ。
words.example: I visited Australia for the first time three years ago.

words.englishDefinition: High quality porcelain originally made only in China
words.japaneseExplanation: 高品質の磁器で、もともとは中国だけで作られた。
words.example: I used it when I was in China last summer.

words.englishDefinition: A politically organized body of people under a single government
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の政府の下に政治的に組織された人々の集まり。
words.example: I had a dream I went back to my country.

words.englishDefinition: People in general; especially a distinctive group of people with some shared interest
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般の人々。特に何らかの共通の利害のある人々の特徴的なグループ。
words.example: How in the world did you do such a thing?

words.englishDefinition: Anew
words.japaneseExplanation: 改めて。
words.example: I tried to get up, but I fell down again.

words.englishDefinition: On one occasion
words.japaneseExplanation: ある時。
words.example: I get a call from her once in a while.

words.englishDefinition: Happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
words.japaneseExplanation: 言及時の後に起こること。
words.example: You knew that sooner or later it would happen, didn't you?

words.englishDefinition: In addition
words.japaneseExplanation: さらに。
words.example: I also found every letter he had ever written to my mother.

words.englishDefinition: On certain occasions or in certain cases but not always
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の機会、あるいは特定の場合においてしかし、常にではない。
words.example: My little sister sometimes wished she was a boy.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo a transformation or a change of position or action
words.japaneseExplanation: 変形または位置または行動の変化を受ける。
words.example: We cannot allow them to turn us against each other.

words.englishDefinition: Take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
words.japaneseExplanation: 行動を行うことで、第一歩、一歩以上を踏み出す。
words.example: We will begin the party when he comes.

words.englishDefinition: Move while supporting, either in a vehicle or in one's hands or on one's body
words.japaneseExplanation: 車両で、人手で、または、身に付けて、維持している間に移動する。
words.example: You must carry the keys with you at all times.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo an emotional sensation or be in a particular state of mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 感情的な気持ちを経験する、または特定の心理状態になる。
words.example: I want them to feel what I felt.

words.englishDefinition: Keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の状態、位置または活動を維持する。例えば、。
words.example: My father often tells me to keep things clean.

words.englishDefinition: The capital and largest city of England; located on the Thames in southeastern England; financial and industrial and cultural center
words.japaneseExplanation: イングランドの首都で最大の都市。イングランド南東部のテムズ川沿岸に位置する。
words.example: I made friends with her during my stay in London.

words.englishDefinition: A football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal
words.japaneseExplanation: 11人の選手2チームがキックやヘッドでボールを相手ゴールに入れるフットボールの試合。
words.example: Our soccer team won every game last season.

words.englishDefinition: A game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop
words.japaneseExplanation: 5人で成る2つのチームによるコート上で行われる試合。高い位置にある水平のリングを通じてボールを投げることで、得点がされる。
words.example: I play in the basketball team.

words.englishDefinition: A game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands
words.japaneseExplanation: 2チームがふくらんだボールを、手を使って高いネットの向こうに打ち飛ばすゲーム。
words.example: I forgot you were on the volleyball team.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various games played with a ball (round or oval) in which two teams try to kick or carry or propel the ball into each other's goal
words.japaneseExplanation: ボール（丸または楕円）を用いる様々なゲームで、2つの相対するチームが互いのゴールにそのボールを蹴り込んだり、運び込んだり、押し込んだりする。
words.example: How many times a week does the football team practice?

words.englishDefinition: A sports implement (usually consisting of a handle and an oval frame with a tightly interlaced network of strings) used to strike a ball (or shuttlecock) in various games
words.japaneseExplanation: 様々なゲームにおいてボール（またはシャトル）を打つのに用いられるスポーツ用具（柄とストリングをきつく網状にからみ合せた卵形の枠とでできた）。
words.example: I can't sleep with all this racket going on.

words.englishDefinition: A category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通の特徴や質で区別されるものの範疇。
words.example: I think there has been some kind of mistake.

words.englishDefinition: The basic monetary unit in many countries; equal to 100 cents
words.japaneseExplanation: 多くの国で使われている通貨の基本単位。100セントと同価。
words.example: Can you help me out by giving me a dollar?

words.englishDefinition: A state of difficulty that needs to be resolved
words.japaneseExplanation: 解決する必要のある困難な状況。
words.example: Our problem is how to get in touch with him.

words.englishDefinition: Activities that are enjoyable or amusing
words.japaneseExplanation: 楽しい、おもしろい活動。
words.example: I do this for the fun of it.

words.englishDefinition: At all times; all the time and on every occasion
words.japaneseExplanation: いつも、常に。いつもそしてあらゆる機会に。
words.example: I will always love you no matter what you do.

words.englishDefinition: From a particular thing or place or position ('forth' is obsolete)
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のもの、場所または位置から。
words.example: I don't want to talk to you anymore. Go away.

words.englishDefinition: possibly; perhaps
words.japaneseExplanation: 確実ではない可能性を表す「たぶん」「もしかすると」。
words.example: Maybe we can go to the beach tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: With ease ('easy' is sometimes used informally for 'easily')
words.japaneseExplanation: 容易さをもって。
words.example: I hope that he will find his way easily.

words.englishDefinition: From a particular thing or place or position ('forth' is obsolete)
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のもの、場所または位置から。
words.example: I want to get off at the next stop.

words.englishDefinition: Know and comprehend the nature or meaning of
words.japaneseExplanation: 本来の姿、あるいは意味を知り、理解する。
words.example: I can understand what she is saying.

words.englishDefinition: The content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about
words.japaneseExplanation: 認知の内容。その人が考えている主要な事柄。
words.example: What do you think about this idea?

words.englishDefinition: The time yet to come
words.japaneseExplanation: まだ到来していない時間。
words.example: I never think about the future. It comes soon enough.

words.englishDefinition: A special situation
words.japaneseExplanation: 特殊状況。
words.example: I got half the things you asked me to get.

words.englishDefinition: The most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も普通に使われている交換手段。法定貨幣として機能している。
words.example: What makes us free is the money, not the law.

words.englishDefinition: A message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
words.japaneseExplanation: 出来事の行為、発生、詳細、進行を伝えるメッセージ。文書、劇、映画の中で、あるいはラジオまたはテレビの番組として示さた。
words.example: You didn't tell the story very well.

words.englishDefinition: A formally arranged gathering
words.japaneseExplanation: 公式に準備された集まり。
words.example: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: A course of conduct
words.japaneseExplanation: 行動の方針。
words.example: We understood that it was much better for us this way.

words.englishDefinition: A unit of language that native speakers can identify
words.japaneseExplanation: ネイティブスピーカーが同定できる言語の単位。
words.example: I took him on his word when he said he'd never seen her before.

words.englishDefinition: The point in time at which something ends
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが終わる時期。
words.example: I won't wait for you until the end of time.

words.englishDefinition: The physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの物理的大きさ（どれほど大きいか）。
words.example: My dog is almost half the size of yours.

words.englishDefinition: A systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols
words.japaneseExplanation: 音または慣習的記号を用いたコミュニケーションの体系的な手段。
words.example: I wish I could speak all the languages of the world.

words.englishDefinition: One of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes
words.japaneseExplanation: 堅い紙の小片のセットの１つで、色々な印がつけられていて、ゲームをしたり、運勢を占ったりするのに使用される。
words.example: You will need a video card to play this game.

words.englishDefinition: The work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かまたは何かに処遇を施したり、または注意を払うこと。
words.example: I don't care what happens to my old car.

words.englishDefinition: A series of mental images and emotions occurring during sleep
words.japaneseExplanation: 睡眠中に起こる一連の精神的イメージと感情。
words.example: I saw it all in a dream last night.

words.englishDefinition: (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball
words.japaneseExplanation: 野球で打者かランナーが無事に塁に到着することの失敗。
words.example: I hope you get that out of your system.

words.englishDefinition: as much or as many as needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な量や程度を満たしていること。enough time、old enough の語順に注意。
words.example: We have enough time to finish the game.

words.englishDefinition: A static photograph (especially one taken from a movie and used for advertising purposes)
words.japaneseExplanation: （特に映画からとったもので宣伝目的に使われる）静止写真。
words.example: Do you think he still wants to live with me?

words.englishDefinition: Up to the present time
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在今に至るまで。
words.example: I haven't yet had time to see about a hotel for the night.

words.englishDefinition: used to identify a point in place or time
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所や時刻などの一点を示す前置詞。
words.example: Let's meet at the station at ten.

words.englishDefinition: Persist for a specified period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の期間やり通す。
words.example: I wonder how long this cold weather will last.

words.englishDefinition: in a good or skillful way
words.japaneseExplanation: 動作が上手にできることを表す副詞。
words.example: My sister plays the piano very well.

words.englishDefinition: Able to act at will; not hampered; not under compulsion or restraint
words.japaneseExplanation: 意のままに行動することができる。妨げられない。
words.example: Please feel free to stay as long as you like.

words.englishDefinition: Increase in size by natural process
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然なプロセスによるサイズの増加。
words.example: I don't want our child to grow up here.

words.englishDefinition: Regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に一般大衆によってとても好かれ、受け入れられ、愛されている。
words.example: I am a popular girl at school.

words.englishDefinition: liked more than others
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかのものより特に好きなこと。
words.example: What is your favorite food to cook at home?

words.englishDefinition: Take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 自らで、何かまたは誰かをどこかへ連れて行く。
words.example: Please bring me a chair from the next room.

words.englishDefinition: A period of time equal to 1/24th of a day
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間の周期、1日の1/24と等しい。
words.example: How many more hours do you think this will take?

words.englishDefinition: as much or as many as needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な量や程度を満たしていること。enough time、old enough の語順に注意。
words.example: We have enough time to finish the game.

words.englishDefinition: Become part of; become a member of a group or organization
words.japaneseExplanation: 一部になる。グループか組織のメンバーになる。
words.example: I think I should join a study group.

words.englishDefinition: a place where trains stop for passengers
words.japaneseExplanation: 列車に乗ったり降りたりする駅。
words.example: I'll meet you outside the station at nine.

words.englishDefinition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡単でない。完成させ、理解しまたは我慢する物理的または精神的努力を必要とする。
words.example: I realize this is a difficult time for you.

words.englishDefinition: The particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
words.japaneseExplanation: ある原因によって生み出された特定の聴覚的効果。
words.example: I love the sound of rain on the roof.

words.englishDefinition: The child of your aunt or uncle
words.japaneseExplanation: おじやおばの子供。
words.example: My cousin is the last person to break his promise.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various alternatives; some other
words.japaneseExplanation: 様々な選択肢の総称。他の何かの。
words.example: I want to put off the lesson until another day.

words.englishDefinition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
words.japaneseExplanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
words.example: I ask you to remember this once and for all.

words.englishDefinition: Place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業上であるか事務員の義務が実行される勤務地。
words.example: I have important business to take care of in my office.

words.englishDefinition: Easily agitated
words.japaneseExplanation: 興奮しやすい。
words.example: I didn't know that you were going to be nervous.

words.englishDefinition: Save from ruin, destruction, or harm
words.japaneseExplanation: 荒廃、破壊または損害から救う。
words.example: You are the only one who can save the world.

words.englishDefinition: The organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 政治体の行政部門である組織。
words.example: What do you do for the government?

words.englishDefinition: A health facility where patients receive treatment
words.japaneseExplanation: 患者が治療を受ける健康設備。
words.example: I went to the hospital to ask about his health.

words.englishDefinition: Reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的地に着く。動くことまたは前進によって到着する。
words.example: We won't be able to arrive home in time.

words.englishDefinition: Many times at short intervals
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い間隔で、何回も。
words.example: I often think of the place where we met each other.

words.englishDefinition: Not ever; at no time in the past or future
words.japaneseExplanation: かつてないさま。過去または未来にすることのないさま。
words.example: I had never felt more alone than at that time.

words.englishDefinition: Render inoperable or ineffective
words.japaneseExplanation: 実行できなくする、または効果をなくす。
words.example: How old were you when the war broke out?

words.englishDefinition: Any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーを伝送あるいは変形して、人間の仕事をさせたり助けさせたりする機械的あるいは電気的装置一般。
words.example: I can't seem to get him to fix this machine.

words.englishDefinition: Prior to a specified or implied time
words.japaneseExplanation: 指定されたか意味された時間の前に。
words.example: I must have told you that a hundred times already.

words.englishDefinition: Get something; come into possession of
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを得る。所有物として手に入れる。
words.example: I hope to receive a letter from you soon.

words.englishDefinition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
words.japaneseExplanation: 鉛筆やペンなどで絵や図を描くこと。
words.example: Can you draw a map of your neighborhood?

words.englishDefinition: during the time that; in contrast with
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜している間に」や「一方で」を表す接続詞。
words.example: I listened to music while I cleaned my room.

words.englishDefinition: to take something to the person or place that needs it
words.japaneseExplanation: 荷物などを相手や目的地まで届けること。
words.example: Can you deliver this package to our office tomorrow?

words.englishDefinition: A set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術あるいは知識を評価するための、一連の質問や問題。
words.example: We heard the news that you had passed the exam.

words.englishDefinition: from a time in the past; because
words.japaneseExplanation: 時点を示すと「〜以来」。理由を示すと「〜なので」。
words.example: I have lived in this town since April.

words.englishDefinition: Descend in free fall under the influence of gravity
words.japaneseExplanation: 重力の影響を受けている時、歯止めなく落下する。
words.example: I could fall in love with you all over again.

words.englishDefinition: A building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented
words.japaneseExplanation: 演劇や映画が上演される建物。
words.example: Could you show me the way to the theater?

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or belonging to a nation or country
words.japaneseExplanation: 国または国家に属する、またはそれに関係するまたはそれの。
words.example: We took a trip to a national park.

words.englishDefinition: The accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 行事や活動に直接かかわることで得た技術や知識の蓄積。
words.example: I have some experience in that area as well.

words.englishDefinition: Capable of happening or existing
words.japaneseExplanation: 起きるまたは存在できる。
words.example: I want to read as many English books as possible this year.

words.englishDefinition: Of so extreme a degree or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 程度や範囲が非常に極端な。
words.example: I really dream of such a tree in my garden.

words.englishDefinition: Regard something as probable or likely
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かに対して、起こり得る、または見込まれると見なす。
words.example: You can expect me tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: High in price or charging high prices
words.japaneseExplanation: 値段が高い、または高い値段で請求する。
words.example: I can't afford to shop at such an expensive store.

words.englishDefinition: weighing a lot
words.japaneseExplanation: 重さが大きく、持つのに力が必要なこと。
words.example: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.

words.englishDefinition: Move very fast
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に速く動く。
words.example: We have very little time, so please hurry.

words.englishDefinition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
words.example: We should invent a secret language.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by absence of sound
words.japaneseExplanation: 音の欠如で、マークされます。
words.example: I kept silent because I didn't know what to say.

words.englishDefinition: Attack someone physically or emotionally
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的または感情的にだれかを攻撃する。
words.example: We didn't intend to attack him.

words.englishDefinition: Do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of
words.japaneseExplanation: 処分する、破壊あるいは破滅を引き起こす。
words.example: Do you think that you need to destroy my things?

words.englishDefinition: The totality of surrounding conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 総体的な周囲の状況。
words.example: We do not respect the environment as much as we should.

words.englishDefinition: Form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在しない、あるいは、事実と異なる心像を形成する。
words.example: I can imagine why you don't want to talk to her.

words.englishDefinition: Pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs
words.japaneseExplanation: 脳動脈の拡張、筋肉収縮、薬反応による頭痛。
words.example: Do you have something to make this headache go away?

words.englishDefinition: Not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人的でない。全体の人に対してまたはそれに関して。
words.example: I went to a public garden to rest.

words.englishDefinition: Traverse or travel on (a body of water)
words.japaneseExplanation: （水域の上を）渡るまたは行く。
words.example: Do you know how to sail a boat?

words.englishDefinition: a planned piece of work with a particular purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的を達成するために計画して進める仕事や課題。
words.example: Our class is working on a project about recycling.

words.englishDefinition: At the present or from now on; usually used with a negative
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在において、または今から。
words.example: Our children don't live here anymore.

words.englishDefinition: Propel through the air
words.japaneseExplanation: 空気中で推進する。
words.example: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.

words.englishDefinition: To a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常よりも目立って大きな程度にまたは範囲に。
words.example: My wife makes me happy, especially when she isn't home.

words.englishDefinition: On the inside
words.japaneseExplanation: 内から。
words.example: I wasn't able to see who was inside the car.

words.englishDefinition: Sleep longer than intended
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図するより長い睡眠。
words.example: How did I oversleep even though I went to bed early?!

words.englishDefinition: Make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の目的、使用、あるいは出来事のためにあらかじめ準備しておく、整える、備える。
words.example: I have to prepare to go to school.

words.englishDefinition: At or in the front
words.japaneseExplanation: 前面のまたは前面で。
words.example: I can see so much light ahead of me.

words.englishDefinition: Move upward
words.japaneseExplanation: 上方に動く。
words.example: We are waiting for the sun to rise.

words.englishDefinition: next to someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物のすぐ横にある位置を表す。
words.example: Please put your bag beside the desk.

words.englishDefinition: in opposition to; touching and supported by
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜に反対して」「〜に接して」などを表す前置詞。
words.example: Our team is playing against theirs on Saturday.

words.englishDefinition: not anything
words.japaneseExplanation: 「何も〜ない」を表す否定の代名詞。
words.example: There is nothing in this box.

words.englishDefinition: A diagram or picture illustrating textual material
words.japaneseExplanation: 本文を説明する図表や写真。
words.example: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

words.englishDefinition: Take into custody
words.japaneseExplanation: 保護する。
words.example: I doubt that the police are going to arrest Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Get lost, as without warning or explanation
words.japaneseExplanation: 道に迷う、警告あるいは説明なしで。
words.example: My money seems to disappear by the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: The line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
words.japaneseExplanation: 空と大地が接しているように見える線。
words.example: Do you see a ship on the horizon?

words.japanese: 親しみやすい、友好的な
words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of or befitting a friend
words.japaneseExplanation: 友人の特徴または、に適するさま。
words.example: My uncle gave me a friendly piece of advice.

words.englishDefinition: Run away from confinement
words.japaneseExplanation: 監禁から逃げる。
words.example: You won't be able to escape from this prison.

words.englishDefinition: Make plain and comprehensible
words.japaneseExplanation: 平易で理解可能にする。
words.example: I found it impossible to explain what he is really like.

words.englishDefinition: Absolutely essential
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要不可欠な。
words.example: Do you really believe that doing that is absolutely necessary?

words.englishDefinition: Impress positively
words.japaneseExplanation: 明らかに印象づける。
words.example: You don't have to try so hard to impress me.

words.englishDefinition: the number one thousand million
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在の一般的な英語では十億を表す。
words.example: More than a billion people live in India.

words.englishDefinition: feeling that you need a drink
words.japaneseExplanation: 水分が欲しくて、のどが渇いていること。
words.example: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water?

words.englishDefinition: Produce laughter
words.japaneseExplanation: 笑いを引き起こす。
words.example: I didn't know whether to get angry or to laugh.

words.englishDefinition: A set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術あるいは知識を評価するための、一連の質問や問題。
words.example: We felt happy when the examination was over.

words.englishDefinition: Afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief
words.japaneseExplanation: 気がかりな不安、トラブルまたは悲しみに苦しめられるまたは、それらに特徴付けられる。
words.example: I used to get upset about everything, too.

words.englishDefinition: Cultivate by growing, often involving improvements by means of agricultural techniques
words.japaneseExplanation: 育成して栽培する、しばしは農業技術の方法の改良を含む。
words.example: We don't produce anything any more.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being important and worthy of note
words.japaneseExplanation: 重要で、注目に値するという特質。
words.example: Do you understand the importance of what you are saying?

words.englishDefinition: Not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
words.japaneseExplanation: 生じることができない、達成されない、または対処されることができない。
words.example: We find ourselves in an impossible situation.

words.englishDefinition: A time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、金曜日の夜から日曜日までの期間。日曜日、あるいは一度のみの日曜日を含む連続した日付期間のいずれかであると緩く定義された。
words.example: I want to spend time with my children this weekend.

words.englishDefinition: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 労働を離れた余暇時間で、休息または娯楽に用いられる。
words.example: I can't remember the last time I took a vacation.

words.englishDefinition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
words.japaneseExplanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
words.example: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

words.englishDefinition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
words.example: I don't feel well. Could you give me some medicine?

words.englishDefinition: Behave as expected during of holidays or rites
words.japaneseExplanation: 休日または儀式で予想通りに振舞う。
words.example: I want to celebrate Christmas with you.

words.englishDefinition: An announcement containing information about an event
words.japaneseExplanation: イベントについての情報を含んでいる発表。
words.example: Do you notice anything different about me?

words.englishDefinition: Be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
words.japaneseExplanation: 胸を痛める、憂慮している、案じている、問題を抱えている、または不安である。
words.example: I don't think it's anything we need to worry about.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being suitable or opportune
words.japaneseExplanation: 適当で好都合な状態。
words.example: You pay for the convenience of living near a station.

words.englishDefinition: for the reason that
words.japaneseExplanation: 理由を説明する語。後ろに主語と動詞を置く。
words.example: I took the bus because it was raining.
